points.name: Homomonument
points.e: The Homomonument is a memorial in the centre of Amsterdam, the capital of the Netherlands. It commemorates all LGBTQ people who have been persecuted because of their sexual orientation. Opened on 5 September 1987, it was the first monument in the world to commemorate gays and lesbians who were killed by the German Nazi regime.

points.name: Leeuw
points.e: The National Monument on Dam Square (Dutch: Nationaal Monument op de Dam) is a 1956 cenotaph in Amsterdam, Netherlands. A national Remembrance of the Dead ceremony is held at the monument every year on 4 May to commemorate the casualties of World War II and subsequent armed conflicts.

points.name: Hollandsche Schouwburg
points.e: The Hollandsche Schouwburg (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔlɑntsə ˈsxʌubʏr(ə)x]; English: Hollandic Theatre) is a museum in Amsterdam in the Netherlands.

points.name: De Schreeuw
points.e: De Schreeuw (The Scream) is a sculpture in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam that commemorates the assassinated Dutch film-maker Theo van Gogh. The monument was designed by Jeroen Henneman as a symbol of freedom of speech.

points.name: Ruiterstandbeeld van Koningin Wilhelmina
points.e: The equestrian statue of Queen Wilhelmina in Amsterdam is located on Rokin street, at the corner with Langebrugsteeg alley. The statue of Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands was sculpted in bronze by Theresia R. van der Pant. The statue was commissioned by the Amsterdam Contact Group of Women's Organisations in 1964.

points.name: National Holocaust Names Memorial
points.e: The National Holocaust Names Memorial (Amsterdam) (Dutch: Holocaust Namenmonument) is since 2021 the Dutch national memorial for the Holocaust and the Porajmos at Amsterdam.

points.name: De Dokwerker
points.e: De Dokwerker is a statue and memorial on the Jonas Daniël Meijerplein in Amsterdam, commemorating the February Strike of 1941. The statue was designed and made by the sculptor Mari Andriessen, commissioned by the Amsterdam municipal government.

points.name: 11 Rue Crubellier
points.e: 11 Rue Simon-Crubellier is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Animaris Rhinoceros Transport
points.e: The Animaris rhinoceros transport is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artwork was designed by artist and inventor Theo Jansen, who is best known for his moving objects in the form of strandbeesten, mainly skeletons made of plastic, which keep themselves moving once set in motion.

points.name: Atatürk Memorial
points.e: The Atatürk Memorial is a monument in Amsterdam-Noord. The artist M. Turkmen, otherwise unknown, designed a monument with a dual meaning.

points.name: Belle
points.e: Belle is a 2007 sculpture on the Oudekerksplein in Amsterdam, made by the Dutch sculptor Els Rijerse on commission from the Prostitutie Informatie Centrum (PIC). The bronze figure on a granite plinth pays tribute to sex workers worldwide, and the initiator was former prostitute Mariska Majoor. Belle is French for 'beautiful'.

points.name: Dragers van verre
points.e: Dragers van verre is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a creation by Nelson Carrilho, standing since 1989 in the Westerpark in Amsterdam. The poet Kenneth Echteld on the statue: "Let us pause to consider that every person, wherever they come from or are going to, has brought and carries their cultural richness."

points.name: Figure découpée
points.e: Figure découpée or L'oiseau (1963, 1964, 1965) is an abstract sculpture by Pablo Picasso: there are a total of three Figure découpée sculptures. There is one located in Vondelpark NL, another on the campus of Massachusetts Institute of Technology in the United States and another is in Helsingborg Sweden.

points.name: Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord
points.e: Fusilladeplaats Rozenoord is a World War II memorial in the Dutch city of Amsterdam. 'Fusilladeplaats' might be translated into English as 'firing squad place'. 'Rozenoord' was originally a rose garden, whose name was adopted during the 1930s by a teahouse by the Amsteldijk, a dyke in Amsterdam.

points.name: Het Lieverdje
points.e: Het Lieverdje is a statue on the Spui in Amsterdam. It was made by the Amsterdam sculptor Carel Kneulman.

points.name: Levensboom
points.t: Tree of Life, Monument of Awareness
points.e: The Tree of Life, Monument of Awareness (Bon Fu Gron Prakseri) is a monument located at Surinameplein in Amsterdam-West, commemorating the history of slavery, the abolition of slavery, and the solidarity among the countries that were part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. The monument was designed by Henry Renfurm. It was unveiled on June 30, 2003.

points.name: Mama Baranka
points.e: Mama Baranka is an artwork in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid, in memory of the death of Kerwin Duinmeijer. The statue is an initiative of Fundashon Antiano Amsterdam (Antillean welfare foundation).

points.name: Man met vioolkist
points.e: The Blue Violin Player or De Blauwe Vioolspeler (1982) is a metal sculpture located near the Raampoortbrug bridge in Amsterdam Netherlands. It is also called Man Trying to Catch Tram 10 or Man with Violin Case. The identity of the artist is unknown.

points.name: Monument Indië-Nederland
points.e: The Monument Indië-Nederland is located near the Olympiaplein in the southern part of Amsterdam. The monument was originally a memorial for General J. B. van Heutsz, who was the commandant of the Royal Netherlands East Indies Army and is also known for conquering Aceh for the Kingdom of the Netherlands in 1903 following the Aceh War.

points.name: Naatje of Dam Square
points.e: Naatje van de Dam or Naatje op de Dam, officially De Eendracht, was a monument that stood on the Dam in Amsterdam, opposite the Palace on the Dam, between 1856 and 1914.

points.name: Rembrandt
points.e: The Rembrandt monument is a 19th-century memorial to the painter Rembrandt van Rijn on the Rembrandtplein in Amsterdam. It is the oldest surviving statue in Amsterdam and was the first statue of a visual artist in the Netherlands.

points.name: Spinoza
points.e: The Spinoza Monument (2008) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It came close to never being realised: in the run-up period, the Amsterdam municipality wanted a statue of Baruch Spinoza as a figurehead of Amsterdam's tolerance.

points.name: Tegen alle stromen in
points.e: Against the Tide (Dutch: Tegen alle stromen in), sometimes referred to by its more literal translation as Against All Currents, by Rini Hurkmans, is a memorial sculpture honoring murdered Dutch journalist Peter R. de Vries who was shot on July 6, 2021, and died on July 15, 2021. It was unveiled on July 15, 2024.

points.name: Van Tuyll-monument
points.e: The Van Tuyll Monument, also known as De Olympische groet, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945
points.e: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is a monument on the Museumplein in Amsterdam commemorating the Dutch victims of Ravensbrück, the Nazi concentration camp for women in Germany.

points.name: 'Voetballers'
points.e: Voetballers is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. At the request of Pierre Janssen, and on commission from the Amsterdam municipality, Ek van Zanten depicted two footballers fighting over the ball. Amsterdam wanted a tribute at the Olympic Stadium to the Dutch footballers who finished second at the 1974 World Cup (and possibly also 1978).

points.name: 101 Namen
points.e: 101 Namen is a two-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is an artwork by Martine Neddam, born in Algeria but living in Amsterdam-West in 1996. The location is the Van Swindenspoorbrug between the Eerste Van Swindenstraat and the Javastraat, on the side of the Pontanusstraat.

points.name: 178 Bottles, 1 Message
points.e: 178 Bottles, 1 Message is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Westpoort. It is a creation by Lieuwe Martijn Wijnands and Saskia Hoogendoorn, working under Art & Design Tijdmakers. It was made in 2014 and consists of LED lighting and steel. The artists were inspired by the nationalities represented in Amsterdam that year.

points.name: 2 U's naar buiten, 2 U's naar binnen
points.t: 2 U's naar buiten, 2 U's naar binnen
points.e: 2 U's naar buiten, 2 U's naar binnen is a two-part artistic artwork standing in the Bos en Lommerplantsoen, Amsterdam Oud-West. The area around the Bos en Lommerplein underwent a transformation around 1960. This was caused by the construction of the GAK building, also known as the aquarium.

points.name: 270 degrees
points.e: 270 degrees is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is applied art. The three concrete objects offer a somewhat sheltered spot for birdwatchers who want to watch the birds that have settled in the Osdorper Binnenpolder-Zuid. The area is designated as one of the last medieval landscapes around Amsterdam.

points.name: 4 en 5 mei monument
points.e: The Monument Holendrecht is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue is a creation by Maria Glandorf from 1984. The full inscription reads Monument Holendrecht in memory of the resistance and the liberation. In two bronze human-like figures on a concrete plinth, it depicts the eternal struggle between people and power.

points.name: 43 Kinderen
points.e: 43 Kinderen is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: 5 elementen
points.e: Zes cirkelelementen is the unofficial title of a group of sculptures in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: 7 poorten
points.e: Poorten van Noord or De 7 poorten is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artwork was designed by Margit Lukács and Persijn Broersen. It was erected during the construction of the Noorderpark metro station on the North/South line.

points.name: 8 Decembermonument
points.e: The 8 Decembermonument is a monument in Amsterdam-Centrum. The monument was unveiled on 8 December 1992 at the tenth commemoration of the December murders of 8 December 1982 at Fort Zeelandia in Suriname. It consists of a plaque placed on the southern side wall of the Mozes en Aäronkerk on the Mr. Visserplein.

points.name: Aanvallende stier
points.t: Lantaarns en fonteinen aan het Beursplein
points.e: The Lanterns and fountains on the Beursplein are artworks in Amsterdam-Centrum. Together they have been a national monument (rijksmonument) since 22 April 2002. The design of both the street furniture and the Beursplein itself is by Berlage and dates from 1902, when building was in full swing at the Beurs. Two lanterns stand on the landing.

points.name: Abri
points.e: Abri en peperbus is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is placed on the Van Limburg Stirumplein in the Staatsliedenbuurt. The work by Frank Halmans consists of two parts, a tram shelter and a pepperpot.

points.name: abstract
points.e: Schelpvorm is an abstract artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer. The non-figurative sculpture by Joop Hollanders stands at the intersection of the Kruislaan and the Radioweg. The work also shows Hollanders' signature; it consists of bodies pushed into and over each other, which are also attached to each other here.

points.name: Abstract ornament
points.e: Ode aan een gladde iep is a temporary artistic artwork, intended as such, in the Westerpark. It is the work of Dirk Versluis.

points.name: ADM-monument
points.e: The ADM Monument is an artwork that doubles as a memorial in Amsterdam-Noord. The old grounds of the Amsterdamse Droogdok Maatschappij (ADM) on the IJ were built over in the 1980s with the IJplein neighbourhood. Within the street plan designed by Rem Koolhaas and Jan Voorberg, the street and square Het Dok (nickname of the ADM) was planned.

points.name: Air Quality Measuring Station Jan van Galenstraat
points.e: The Meetstation Jan van Galenstraat is a measuring station and artwork in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: Aldo van Eyck aan het Bertelmanplein
points.t: Aldo van Eyck aan het Bertelmanplein
points.e: Aldo van Eyck aan het Bertelmanplein is an overview of play equipment that the architect Aldo van Eyck designed for the Bertelmanplein in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Alle eendjes zwemmen in het water
points.t: Alle eendjes zwemmen in het water
points.e: Alle eendjes zwemmen in het water is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a creation by artist René Nijssen from 1975, according to the signature on the statue. Nijssen had then just traded abstract expressionism for a more figurative style.

points.name: Alliantiewapen Oranje-Nassau en Waldeck-Pyrmont
points.e: The Alliantiewapen Oranje-Nassau en Waldeck-Pyrmont is a relief in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is one of the many sculptures that adorn the facades of Amsterdam Centraal station. It was installed during construction; it dates from the period 1881 to 1889, when the station was being built.

points.name: Amelia
points.e: Amelia, colloquially known as Meisje met skippybal, is an artistic artwork standing in the Tweede Weteringsplantsoen, Amsterdam-Centrum. Chris Schraven made this statue to mark the completion of a renovation of the Marnixbad.

points.name: Amphitrite
points.e: The artwork Amphitrite is a bronze group of statues and fountain on the KNSM-eiland in Amsterdam-Oost, made by Albert Termote in 1956 for the Koninklijke Nederlandse Stoomboot-Maatschappij (KNSM). Amphitrite is the name of a Greek sea goddess. Most KNSM ships had names drawn from Greek or Roman mythology.

points.name: Amsterdam Oersoep
points.a: Hans van Bentem, Arno Coenen en Iris Roskam
points.e: Amsterdam Oersoep is a large public artwork in the Beurspassage in Amsterdam. It came about in 2016, when the building at Damrak 70-79 was thoroughly renovated on commission from owner Bouwinvest and partly given new tenants. The low, dark passage was raised and richly decorated with an enormous total artwork.

points.name: An outcast sanctuary
points.e: An outcast sanctuary is an artistic artwork placed in Amsterdam-Oost, Zeeburgereiland. On that island, a large skate park with all kinds of slopes etc. was built from 2018 to 2020. In 2018, the artist duo Iris Roskam and Arno Coenen were commissioned to fill the 'blind walls' with tableaux.

points.name: Anachoreoo
points.e: Anachoreoo is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a construction by artist Berend Strik and is placed in/above Park Frankendael. Strik was inspired by follies, a common phenomenon in the 18th and 19th centuries at country estates.

points.name: André Hazes
points.e: André Hazes was a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum. In 2020, artist Street Art Frankey had a statue of André Hazes placed. It was one of the larger statues by Street Art Frankey, who is known in Amsterdam for his small artworks that brighten up the cityscape.

points.name: Angel of Death
points.e: De Engel des doods is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer. Sculptor Fred Carasso made his bronze rendering of the Engel des doods, also called Geest van de dood, in 1955. Over the years the work has been largely invisible; it hung on the back of the hall of the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery.

points.name: Angstig konijn
points.e: Angstig konijn, colloquially known as Angsthaas, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artist himself calls it Anxiety rabbit. Between 2000 and 2019, the Appelsap Fresh Music Festival organised an annual hip-hop festival in the Flevopark in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Animeertegels
points.e: Animeertegels is an educational artwork from 2001 in Amsterdam-Oost. The work was devised by Kees Aafjes and is incorporated into the pavement of the Eikenplein, Oosterparkbuurt. The artwork consists of a kind of barcode of composite concrete, which marks out the play area of the schoolchildren.

points.name: Ankh
points.e: Ankh is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue is placed on the northwestern embankment of the Wiegbrug and was installed after a complete renewal of this bridge in the period 1988-1990. Ankh is an ancient Egyptian symbol for life and/or immortality. The four-metre-high statue is by artist Peter van de Locht.

points.name: Anne Frank
points.e: The statue of Anne Frank on the Westermarkt in Amsterdam is a statue of the German-Jewish girl Anne Frank, who died during the Holocaust at the age of fifteen. Through her diary, Anne Frank has become a worldwide symbol of the victims of the Holocaust.

points.name: Anne Frank Mural
points.e: The Anne Frank Mural is a temporary artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. On the Amstelcampus of the Hogeschool van Amsterdam, at the intersection of the Wibautstraat and the Mauritskade, a small pumping-station building has stood on the Rhijnspoorplein since 1982, which served until 2008.

points.name: Anton de Kom
points.e: The Monument voor Anton de Kom is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

points.name: Anton de Kom mural
points.e: The Anton de Kom Mural is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. This mural was made in late summer 2020 by artist Hedy Tjin. It is part of a series that depicts the Canon van Nederland.

points.name: Apentafel
points.e: Apen aan tafel is a form of art in public space in Amsterdam-West. Around the turn of the millennium, around 2000, parts of the Zeeheldenbuurt were thoroughly renovated. This included the installation of at least two artworks in public space; they share a theme: a table to talk around.

points.name: Apple
points.e: The apple is an artwork by Kees Franse from 1975. It is a large apple made of wood. The work is covered with names and messages from passing travellers.

points.name: Argus
points.e: Argus is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is the work of artist Saske van der Eerden.

points.name: Arie Keppler
points.e: The Bust of Arie Keppler is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. A group of alumni of a local school commissioned the bust from sculptor Constance Wibaut, with financial support from the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunsten, the Woningbedrijf Amsterdam and Stadsdeel Amsterdam-Noord.

points.name: Armonia
points.e: Armonia (Harmoniafontein) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. This relatively small fountain with drinking water was designed by Inti Hernandez (1976), originally from Cuba but living and working from Amsterdam since 2005.

points.name: Arthur van Schendel
points.e: Arthur van Schendel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. On 5 March 1952, the portrait bust of Arthur van Schendel, made by Jobs Wertheim, was unveiled. The unveiling took place in the southern part of the Leidsebosje. Van Schendel's widow, a son and a granddaughter, as well as an alderman, were present.

points.name: Atleet en vrouwenfiguur
points.e: Atleet en vrouwenfiguur are two artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. Both hardstone statues stand at the main entrance (marathon gate) of the Olympic Stadium. At the opening of the stadium they stood in their current place, but over the years they were moved, and in 2006 they returned to their original place.

points.name: Auschwitzmonument
points.e: The Auschwitzmonument, also known as the mirror monument 'Nooit Meer Auschwitz' or Broken Mirrors, is a Dutch memorial in the Wertheimpark in Amsterdam to those who died in the Auschwitz concentration camp and in the other concentration and extermination camps.

points.name: Autoprikker
points.e: De Autoprikker is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a creation by Street Art Frankey and, alongside his Eberhard van der Laan, is his second official work in public space. Frankey places weekly semi-permanent small artworks in Amsterdam on his own initiative, to add some colour to the monotonous streetscape.

points.name: Baadster
points.e: De baadster is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sculptor Hildo Krop had not yet become city sculptor of Amsterdam when the "zwembad Marnix" (colloquially Marnixbad) was built on the Marnixplein to a design by Jan Leupen.

points.name: Bacchus Frankendael
points.e: Bacchus is an artistic artwork in Park Frankendael, Amsterdam-Oost. It is a hardstone statue of Bacchus, god of wine. The maker is unknown. The statue is said to have been placed when Jan Gildemeester lived here from 1759. In 1779 the estate passed to his son Jan Gildemeester Jansz.

points.name: Bachus
points.e: Neptunus, Amphitrite en Arion is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Baksteen sculptuur en vijver
points.e: On the Hildo Kropplein in Amsterdam-Oost stands an untitled artwork by the Danish artist Per Kirkeby. The work is best described as ‘Bakstenen beeld met vijver’ (Brick sculpture with pond). Kirkeby became known for his brick sculptures.

points.name: Bandenboot
points.e: The Bandenboot is an art object from 1974 by Robert Jasper Grootveld (1932-2009) in the Oostelijke Eilanden district of Amsterdam. The work was made on commission from the Amsterdam municipality as a play structure for children, and comprises 225 car tyres held together by chains. Initially it stood on the Wittenburg.

points.name: Banpaal Spaarnwouderdijk
points.e: The Banpaal Spaarnwouderdijk is a ban post (boundary marker) from 1624, which has stood since then on the Spaarndammerdijk outside Amsterdam. The post had just been placed when Rembrandt van Rijn recorded this obelisk-like post on one of his trips, near a farm. He sketched the whole post, but beheaded it in the final etching Landschap met een obelisk.

points.name: Barmhartige Samaritaan
points.e: De barmhartige Samaritaan is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The Sint Lucas Ziekenhuis on the Jan Tooropstraat commissioned the statue in 1985 from artist G.J. ten Wolde (Gert ten Wolde from Franeker). The statue is meant to refer to the Good Samaritan from the parable of the same name.

points.name: Batman en Robin
points.e: Batman en Robin is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. These Batman and Robin are by artist Stef Vedder. In 2006 he made two statues of super cows, as the artist himself describes them. The 2006 version consisted of likenesses of Superman and Spiderman.

points.name: Baubles parade
points.e: The Baubles parade is a collection of artworks placed in the Beatrixpark, Amsterdam-Zuid. A bauble is actually a Christmas bauble. They are the remnants of a collection of balls with mosaics applied to them, which could be seen on the Museumplein in 2012, 2013 and 2014.

points.name: Be Longing
points.e: Totem today is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It consists of several marble columns bearing texts which, according to artist Jennifer Tee, refer to milestones in human history and to the expectation of the near future, with the (apparent) contrast between technology and spirituality.

points.name: Beeld in drie delen
points.e: Beeld in drie delen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artwork is by artist Leo de Vries from 1965. At the time he made all kinds of untitled statues, such as Compositie and Beeld in tien delen.

points.name: Beeld van brons en steen
points.e: In the Erasmuspark in Amsterdam-West stands a Terreinplastiek by Renze Hettema. The abstract statue from 1972 is made of a three-part plinth of basalt. On it rests a bronze sculpture that balances between the parts of the plinth. It measures 280 by 250 by 135 centimetres.

points.name: Beeld van Floor Wibaut
points.e: The Standbeeld voor F.M. Wibaut is a bronze statue by Han Wezelaar, standing in Amsterdam-Oost. In 1959 the Amsterdam municipality commissioned Wezelaar to make a statue of Floor Wibaut. On 24 June of that year the city council released 60,000 guilders for a statue. Making it took a considerable amount of time.

points.name: Beeld van Jacoba van Tongeren
points.e: The statue of Jacoba van Tongeren is a statue of Jacoba van Tongeren, made by Fabio Pravisani, in memory of Van Tongeren and the resistance organisation Groep 2000 which she led.

points.name: Beest
points.e: Het beest is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The stone statue by Nel van Lith can be found near the rose garden of the Eendrachtspark, in the section between De Savornin Lohmanstraat and Burgemeester Röellstraat. This part of the park consists of a grass field with a strict rectangular pattern of paths.

points.name: Behind the rainbow
points.e: Behind the rainbow is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist is Judith de Leeuw (JDL Street Art), who used artificial intelligence for it.

points.name: Berm bunnies
points.e: The Berm bunnies are an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Westpoort. The Port of Amsterdam wanted to break up the monotony of the Nieuwe Hemweg, and in particular of the cycle route Amsterdam-Zaanstad that runs alongside it, with an artwork.

points.name: beschermster en beschermer van de sociale wetgeving en gerechtigheid
points.t: De beschermster van de sociale zorg en gerechtigheid
points.e: De beschermster van de sociale zorg en gerechtigheid is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The Rijksverzekeringbank moved into its building at Apollolaan 15 in Amsterdam in 1939.

points.name: Beursmannetje
points.e: Beursmannetje, official title De krantlezende man, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue by Pieter d'Hont travelled a route through the city before arriving at its spot in 2012. d'Hont designed it in 1964/1965 for the centenary of Het Financieele Dagblad.

points.name: Big Talk
points.e: Big talk is an artwork by Wim Poppinga. It is found at one of the entrances of the Amstelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. In 2007, after a renovation, the park received all kinds of entrance gates, for which artists were enlisted. Wim Poppinga produced a striking gate, set in a kind of Herashekwerk.

points.name: Bijlmermonument
points.e: Het groeiend monument (Bijlmerramp) or Bijlmermonument is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Every year on 4 October, the Bijlmer disaster is commemorated at the monument. Until 2023, a separate foundation, Stichting Beheer Het Groeiend Monument, set up for the purpose, was responsible for the monument.

points.name: Bioom
points.e: Bioom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is partly applied art.

points.name: Birth of change
points.e: Birth of change is an artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos. The artwork stands in the municipality of Amstelveen, to which the park belongs, but its management and so on are handled by the municipality of Amsterdam. The artwork was (partly) designed by artist Serge Verheugen, who supplied several objects for the forest, together called Family ties.

points.name: Blauwe Boog
points.e: De Blauwe boog is a steel sculpture in Amsterdam, Osdorp. It is an abstract work with a geometric form by artist Cyril Lixenberg. The work dates from around 1990 and is said to represent a gateway to the Osdorp district.

points.name: Bloemsilhouetten
points.e: Bloemsilhouetten is the unofficial name for a number of murals in Amsterdam-West. In the 1980s a number of homes in social housing were built in the Kop van Jut neighbourhood, also an unofficial name for the Marcanti neighbourhood. The homes were designed by Sier van Rhijn and executed in brown and white tones.

points.name: Boerderij bij Duivendrecht
points.e: Boerderij bij Duivendrecht is an artistic artwork in Duivendrecht, municipality of Ouder-Amstel. At the beginning of the 1970s, Duivendrecht got a neighbourhood with blocks of flats that show similarities to the (honeycomb) flats in Amsterdam Zuidoost.

points.name: Bolbewoners
points.e: On the grounds of the former Westergasfabriek in Amsterdam-West stands an untitled artistic artwork by Herman Makkink. Colloquially it is called Bolbewoners. The work from 2003/2004 came after a free commission from Kathryn Gustafson of Mecanoo, who was responsible for the redesign of the factory grounds.

points.name: Bolgewas
points.e: Bolgewas is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Bomen, bloemen en planten in vier jaargetijden
points.t: Bomen, bloemen en planten in vier jaargetijden
points.e: Bomen, bloemen en planten in vier jaargetijden is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Boogconstructie
points.e: Boogconstructie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Piet Slegers made the abstract statue for the location of the municipal energy company (GEB) in Amsterdam, which operated from Spaklerweg 20-26. The site was then situated south of the grounds of the Zuidergasfabriek. Slegers came up with a steel arch construction.

points.name: Boom van Hippocrates
points.e: De Boom van Hippocrates is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bright blue statue stands in the Corfuplantsoen in the residential neighbourhood Middelveldsche Akerpolder (De Aker Oost). Artist Adriaan Rees was inspired by the plane tree of Hippocrates, where the Greek Hippocrates of Kos is said to have taught his pupils.

points.name: Boomstronken
points.e: Boomstronken - wortels is a form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Oost. It was designed by Barbara Recourt (visual artist) and Fons Broess (mechanical engineer, industrial designer). The multi-part artwork falls under the category of applied art within the Amsterdam Science Park.

points.name: Boot (Jan Kuipers)
points.e: Boot is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The Frisian artist Jan Kuipers (1943-2014) was asked in 1977 to design a statue for the Bijlmerweide park, which had just been laid out and opened. Several artists designed statues for that park.

points.name: Borduurbloemen XL
points.e: Borduurbloemen XL is an artistic artwork on the Weesperstraat in Amsterdam. In the open space of the municipality of Amsterdam, works in the category Art in public space can be found in all kinds of places. This art comes in all kinds of types, sizes and expressions, from classical statues to 21st-century light installations.

points.name: Borstbeeld Prof. Mr. P.J.M. Aalberse
points.e: The Bust of Prof. Mr. P.J.M. Aalberse is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The Catholic housing association Het Oosten honoured Piet Aalberse with it. In 1938 he was appointed to the Council of State, having been chairman of the House of Representatives. He previously held the office of Minister of Labour and Social Affairs.

points.name: Borstplaat
points.e: Borstplaat and De gestreelde borst are fictional names for a relief in Amsterdam-Centrum. The image lies in the paving of the Oudekerksplein at the side of the Oude Kerk. On the copper tile are two breasts and a hand that grabs one of them.

points.name: Bos Peel
points.e: Bos Peel is an artistic artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos on the territory of the municipality of Amstelveen, but managed by the municipality of Amsterdam. In the place, just north of the Bosbaan, stood a statue by Gabriel Lester from 2016, which fell victim to vandalism in 2018.

points.name: Boulderblok Universum
points.e: The Boulderblok Universum is a structure on the grounds of the Amsterdam Science Park, Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Brains
points.e: Brains is an artistic artwork on the Derkinderenstraat in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work is by Ron Rooymans and/or Jorien Rooijmans-de Kruyff van Dorssen.

points.name: Bredero
points.e: The Bredero Monument is an artwork from 1968 on the Nieuwmarkt in the centre of Amsterdam. The statue in polished bronze on a stone plinth is by sculptor Piet Esser. Esser was inspired for the artwork by a few lines from Gerbrand Adriaensz. Bredero's Spaanschen Brabander.

points.name: Brettensuite
points.e: Beeldenroute Brettensuite is a sculpture trail on the Brettenpad, a cycling and walking route between the Westerpark in Amsterdam-West and Halfweg, largely situated in the Lange Bretten. The sculpture trail consists of 20 sculptures by Herbert Nouwens.

points.name: Bron - Virtual fountains
points.e: Virtual fountains is a three-part artistic artwork (spring, waterfall and fountain) in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Brugknuffel
points.e: Brugknuffel is a sculpture by Herman van der Heide. The concrete artwork from 1962 forms part of the southern railing and balustrade of the Sloterbrug between Amsterdam and Badhoevedorp, over the ring canal of the Haarlemmermeer. The bridge is located within the municipality of Haarlemmermeer.

points.name: Buchenwaldmonument
points.e: The Buchenwald Monument is a monument placed at the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery. The monument, in the form of a gravestone, was unveiled on 26 October 1955.

points.name: Buitenstebinnen
points.e: Buitenstebinnen is a series of murals by artist Dewy Elsinga in the entrances of the Parkeergarage Marnix in Amsterdam. In 2021 construction began on the Parkeergarage Marnix under the Singelgracht. The garage was built by Mobilis TBI on commission from the Amsterdam municipality.

points.name: Buizenkolom
points.e: The Buizenkolom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. This presumably untitled work by André Volten was placed in 1968 at the Merkelbach School, which had then been open for two years. The school on the Arent Janszoon Ernststraat had to accommodate a surplus of pupils due to population growth in Buitenveldert.

points.name: Bullebak (sculpture)
points.e: De Bullebak is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The name goes back to a monster said to pull children into the water, and gives its name to two bridges, both on the Marnixstraat. At the northern end, over the offshoot of the Bloemgracht, lies the Bullebakssluis. The bridges are often mixed up.

points.name: Buurttafel Ambonplein
points.e: Buurttafel Ambonplein is an artistic artwork standing on the Ambonplein, Amsterdam-Oost. The Zeeburg district wanted to bring communities closer together in its neighbourhoods and had neighbourhood tables placed for that purpose. A concrete neighbourhood table was placed on the Ambonplein. Wooden examples were placed elsewhere, such as the Verzonken tafel.

points.name: Capriccio
points.e: Capriccio is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The statue, several metres high, stands on the Oostenburgergracht, where the Oostenburgervoorstraat meets the canal.

points.name: Cascade
points.e: Cascade, or Écriture sur l'eau, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Vondelpark. The statue is a remnant of a sculpture exhibition held in 1965 to celebrate 100 years of the Vondelpark. The exhibition was put together by Willem Sandberg of the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam.

points.name: Ceres
points.e: Ceres (met korenschoof) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Park Frankendael. It is a hardstone statue of Ceres, goddess of arable farming. The maker is unknown. The statue is said to have been placed when Jan Gildemeester lived here from 1759. In 1779 the estate passed to his son Jan Gildemeester Jansz.

points.name: Charlotte
points.e: Charlotte, the nameplate reads Zittend naakt, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue by Hans Sassen (1939) dates from the mid-1970s. Sassen made the statue to comply with the Beeldende Kunstenaars Regeling.

points.name: Chet Baker Plaquette
points.e: The Chet Baker Plaquette is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a small tribute to trumpeter Chet Baker. He died in the night of 12 to 13 May 1988, presumably under the influence, after falling from the window of Hotel Prins Hendrik, located on Prins Hendrikkade 52-58.

points.name: Children's Monument
points.e: The Kindermonument Markt voor Joden (also known as Samen spelen, samen leven) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a three-part group of statues by Truus Menger-Oversteegen, standing since 1986 at the entrance to the playground on the Gaaspstraat.

points.name: Choreography in steel
points.e: Choreografie in staal is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a creation by Margot Zanstra, who here combined two important things for her: dance and sculpture. She was first a ballerina with the Nationaal Ballet, but from 1966 devoted herself to the visual arts.

points.name: Cirkelconstructie
points.e: At the intersection of the Reigersbosdreef and the Meerkerkdreef in Amsterdam-Zuidoost stands an untitled work by Dik Box, who describes himself as Universal Moving Artists. The artwork, a kinetic object, is a circular construction of three aluminium circles and stands in the small park on the roundabout at that intersection.

points.name: Closer in Distance
points.e: Closer in distance is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Since 2016, Amsterdam has had the HIV/AIDS monument by Jean-Michel Othoniel, standing on the De Ruijterkade. It had barely stood for five years when the municipality of Amsterdam had to carry out work on this quay of the IJ; a new ferry pier had to be built.

points.name: Communicatie
points.e: Communicatie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Lotti van der Gaag was asked to brighten up the entrance of the Telefooncentrale Amsterdam-Slotervaart on the Plesmanlaan with a sculpture.

points.name: Complex form
points.e: Complex form is a three-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: compositie
points.e: Compositie, also referred to as Rustende figuur, is a sculpture by Leo de Vries standing in Amsterdam-Oost. The sculpture, made of French limestone (vaurion), is placed in the Galileïplantsoen. At a length of 2.5, a width of 0.65 and a height of 1.6 metres, it is a striking presence in an open grass field.

points.name: Compositie van tien elementen
points.e: Compositie van tien elementen is a form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Noord. In the 1960s the Banne Buiksloot neighbourhood was built, with streets and squares named after concepts from shipping. The park was given the name Koopvaardersplantsoen, after the merchant navy.

points.name: Constructie
points.e: Constructie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artist Shlomo Koren was asked to design a statue during the laying out of the Bijlmerpark (renamed Nelson Mandelapark in 2014).

points.name: Constructie in DIN 2.0
points.e: Constructie in DIN 20 is an artistic artwork standing in the Siegerpark, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The abstract statue by André Volten has been part of the sculpture park of said park since 1998.

points.name: Constructie voor een tuin
points.e: Compositie voor een tuin is an artistic artwork placed in the Siegerpark, Riekerpolder, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue by Shamaï Haber has been part of the sculpture garden of said park since 1998. Unlike the other statues that stand prominently along the paths, Compositie voor een tuin stands in the bushes.

points.name: Construction H-Balk Din 30
points.e: The Constructie H-Balk DIN 30 is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The creation by artist André Volten has stood since 1968 in the Sloterpark, in the section on the east side of the Sloterplas, on the Oostoever street. The artwork consists of three constructions made of welded H-profiles.

points.name: Corned beef
points.e: Corned beef is an artwork by Carolien Feldbrugge. It was installed in 1989 on the Hildo Kropplein, which had been named in 1988. For a century the surrounding area served as Amsterdam's cattle market and central abattoir. Veemarkt and Slachthuisbrug still recall that use.

points.name: Crystal growth
points.e: Crystal growth is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. Housing association Stadgenoot issued commissions for filling the grounds at Eerste Constantijn Huygensstraat 36, where the Jan Swammerdam Institute stood until 2004. The site was filled in sections.

points.name: Curiosity 2015
points.e: Curiosity 2015 is a composite mural in Amsterdam-West. According to the Street Art Museum Amsterdam, it is a combination of two styles of street art, placed on the blank facade of the building at Douwes Dekkerstraat 16, Amsterdam.

points.name: Daarom moet ik wenen
points.e: Daarom moet ik wenen (Al ela ani bochea) or Uittocht der Joden is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost. The facade sculpture by Wessel Couzijn was placed in 1950 during the construction of the complex on the south-western side of the President Brandstraat, at house number 76. Couzijn placed a laden man, woman and child on a sloping pedestal.

points.name: Dachaumonument Amsterdamse Bos
points.e: The Nationaal Dachau Monument is a Dutch memorial to the Dutch victims of the Dachau concentration camp. It is located in the Amsterdamse Bos, opposite the former grandstand of the Bosbaan, and is an initiative of the Nederlands Dachau Comité.

points.name: Dagboekfragment uit Het Achterhuis
points.e: Dagboekfragment uit Het Achterhuis is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a war memorial in memory of Anne Frank. This enormous mural is the work (design and execution) of artist Harry Visser.

points.name: Dansende beer
points.e: Dansende beer is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Dansende beer can be seen on the front facade of the building at Derde Oosterparkstraat 159. The first building at that address dates from around 1888. In the 1970s and 1980s, large-scale demolition took place around that address, and for a long time a gap between the new buildings could be seen on this spot.

points.name: Danser
points.e: Gouden figuur or Danser is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The statue is a creation of artist Henk Visch, whose main theme is movement. This statue is also an example of that. It is placed on an apartment building at the Johanna ter Meulenplein in Amsterdam, which borders the Singelgracht on its south side.

points.name: Danseres met tamboerijn
points.e: Danseres met tamboerijn is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The work by Fioen Blaisse has stood since 2000 in a small park in front of a former school building at the corner of the Purmerweg and Schermerstraat (school building number 3-19). Blaisse wanted her dancer to convey tension and concentration.

points.name: Dapperburen
points.e: Dapperburen (spelled DapperBuren) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Dapperbuurt. The work from 2011 consists of nineteen silhouettes of neighbourhood residents; they are (or were) the neighbours of artist Dorette Evers.

points.name: DDT666
points.e: DDT666 is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. According to the municipality of Amsterdam, it is one of the oldest forms of graffiti in Amsterdam. The small mural was made in 1978 by Ivar Vičs, alias Dr. Rat. Vičs had started the punk club DDT with Diana Ozon.

points.name: De Batavier
points.e: De Boekenkast is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. The artwork consists of a gigantic bookcase built into the outer wall of the De Batavier complex on the Lootsstraat (above the front door of house number 34).

points.name: De beschermer en handhaver van de sociale wetgeving
points.t: De beschermer en handhaver van de sociale wetgeving
points.e: De beschermer en handhaver van de sociale wetgeving is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The Rijksverzekeringsbank moved into its building at Apollolaan 15 in 1939.

points.name: De Bokkenrijder
points.e: De Bokkenrijder (originally "de bokkerijder") is a bronze statue by Gerrit Bolhuis. The statue is placed in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue, a boy on a billy goat, was meant to attract young people to sit behind the boy on the goat.

points.name: De boom valt op mij
points.e: De boom valt op mij (also known as Er is een hoek in de kamer) is a memorial in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: De Bouwvakarbeider
points.e: De Bouwvakarbeider, or De bouwvakker, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bronze statue on a brick plinth stands in a strip of greenery beside the junction of the Burgemeester De Vlugtlaan and the Burgemeester Eliasstraat. It is a work by Jan Havermans from 1962.

points.name: De Bretten
points.e: De Bretten is a signpost and name board. In 2021 the municipality of Amsterdam wanted to put the nature park Lange Bretten more firmly on the map as a recreation area in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The park is an elongated strip of greenery. To that end, the municipality had an extremely large name board placed by the firm Blowups, to its own design.

points.name: De brouwers
points.e: De brouwers is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: De Buurt Optimist
points.e: De Buurt Optimist is a memorial in Amsterdam-Oost in memory of neighbourhood resident Diana Gemert. The bronze artwork was made in 2023 by visual artist Sarah van Sonsbeeck.

points.name: De dag (Hildo Krop)
points.e: De dag is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue dates from the years 1933 to 1937 and belongs to the oeuvre of Hildo Krop. He made De dag for the eye clinic of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. That building stands on the south side of the WG-Plein. Krop depicted a woman kneeling in a field with a bird in her hand.

points.name: De doos
points.e: De doos is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Buitenveldert. The designer of the statue, which is many metres high, is Jeroen Henneman. The work resembles earlier results of his treatment of the theme of the box. Henneman's earlier box statues are smaller: Doos 2 from 1996 is 75 cm high.

points.name: De droom van een hond
points.e: De droom van een hond (A happy dog from Baghdad) is a mosaic in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: De geboorte van de daad
points.e: De Menselijke energie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four stacked statue groups and collages from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool, which were separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

points.name: De geboorte van de daad
points.e: De geboorte van de daad is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four stacked statue groups and collages from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool, which were separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

points.name: De Gevallen Hoornblazer, Amsterdam
points.e: Fusillade, also known as De gevallen hoornblazer, is a bronze statue on the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis. Here, on 12 March 1945, the German army shot thirty political prisoners as a reprisal for an act of resistance.

points.name: De Goede Beul
points.e: Bobby Haarms, De goede beul is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost in honour of Bobby Haarms (1934-2009), a footballer and football coach.

points.name: De hechtsteek
points.e: De hechtsteek is an artwork in Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid. It consists of three ribbon-shaped blue plastic sculptures by Jan Jacobs Mulder. They stand on the De Boelelaan by the VUMC, which has been partly built over the De Boelelaan.

points.name: De hongerwinter
points.e: De hongerwinter is a war memorial on the Oostelijke Eilanden in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is about the Hunger Winter of 1944/1945. It exists in two versions. The original, by Hildo Krop, was placed in the Oosterkerk. It was first fitted on the street side, but over the years it was eroded by weather and soot deposits.

points.name: De kleine kameleon
points.e: De kleine kameleon is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is in fact a collection of artworks from 2008 and 2009, made by Kurdish artist Hoshyar Rasheed to mark the completion of a renovation of the Gerbrandypark. The Stadsdeel Geuzenveld-Slotermeer had asked for it.

points.name: De Knoop
points.e: De knoop is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The name, which has been in circulation for years, refers to an originally untitled work by André Volten. The metres-tall statue is an elaboration of an essentially simple idea: it is a border marker and at the same time a link between Amsterdam-Noord and the IJ.

points.name: De kunstenaar en de muze
points.e: De kunstenaar en de muze is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It consists of two bronze reliefs by Frits van Hall. They were placed around 1927 on the side of the entrance of the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten, which was then still located at Stadhouderskade 86.

points.name: De kus
points.e: De kus is a stainless steel artwork by Jeroen Henneman. It was designed at the request of Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer for placement at its new head office on the Bijlmerdreef in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It was completed in 1982.

points.name: De mensch, de stof opwekkend en beheerschend
points.t: De mensch, de stof opwekkend en beheerschend
points.e: De mensch, de stof opwekkend en beheerschend is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. Theo van Reijn made the statue in 1932 to beautify the facade of the chemistry laboratory building of the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam on De Lairessestraat. The statue is made of tuff stone.

points.name: De moor, de dame en haar hondje
points.t: De moor, de dame en haar hondje
points.e: De moor, de dame en haar hondje is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork comes from the artist duo Berkman and Janssens at the time, Margot Berkman and Eline Janssens. The commission for the work came from ProRail Amsterdam, which faced an entrance in a dead corner on the De Ruijterkade.

points.name: De muur
points.e: De Muur is an artwork in public space in Amsterdam-Noord. It is a creation by Alfred Eikelenboom (1936-2014), who worked on it from 1984 to 1986. In 1987 it was placed on a small field at the IJplein, between the Meeuwenlaan and the Gedempte Insteekhaven.

points.name: De nacht (Hildo Krop)
points.e: De nacht is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue dates from the years 1933 to 1937 and belongs to the oeuvre of Hildo Krop. He made De nacht for the eye clinic of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis. That building stands on the south side of the WG-Plein. Krop depicted a pair of roe deer with an owl on a tree branch above them.

points.name: De oogst
points.e: De oogst (Jan Heyens) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a facade stone designed by Jan Heyens, placed on the housing complex De Dageraad in Amsterdam. That complex is by Michel de Klerk and Piet Kramer, who designed it in a quirky form of the Amsterdam School.

points.name: De Poort van Constant
points.e: De Poort van Constant is an artistic artwork, monument and sculptural sign at the entrance to the Ookmeer sports park on the Troelstralaan, at/over the Herman Bonpad in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. In 2024 it is regarded as a crossover between architecture and visual art.

points.name: De Ratelaar
points.e: De ratelaar is a bronze statue in Amsterdam Oud-West. The work by Rob Cerneüs has stood on the Kwakersplein since 2007 and carries the following inscription: "Ode aan de vuinisman, 130 jaar reiniging 1877-2007".

points.name: De Reus van Bickerseiland sinds 1647
points.e: De Reus van Bickerseiland is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The maker of the original statue is unknown (anonymous, possibly a shipwright), but the image is centuries old. The original statue stood on the Bickerseiland, named after Jan Bicker.

points.name: De scheepstimmerman
points.e: De scheepstimmerman is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The sculptor Johan Polet received the commission in 1954 from the municipality of Amsterdam. After the Second World War, Polet had fallen out of favour because he had been a member of the Kultuurraad.

points.name: De Scheppende Hand & Chaos
points.e: De Scheppende Hand & Chaos are two artistic artworks in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

points.name: De schoone stad aan het IJ
points.t: De schoone stad aan het IJ
points.e: De schoone stad aan het IJ is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It consists of two murals by the artist Moos Cohen. In 1940 he was commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam to make two murals for the Dienst Stadsreiniging on the Bilderdijkkade. After the building was demolished in 2003, the panels were stored for a time.

points.name: De sleutel ligt onder de deurmat
points.t: De sleutel ligt onder de deurmat
points.e: De sleutel ligt onder de deurmat is an artistic doormat in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. At the request of housing corporation Stadgenoot and in collaboration with LEVS Architecten, Martijn Sandberg designed this artwork, 12 by 3 by 23 metres, in the period 2008-2010. It seems big and conspicuous, yet the artwork is hard to find.

points.name: De spiraal
points.e: De spiraal is an artistic artwork in Diemen. The statue dates from 2003 and was designed by Alex Vermeulen. From a pond in an empty space at a traffic junction (Provincialeweg and Weesperstraat), a steel spiral bores counterclockwise into the sky. At its end stands a person.

points.name: De Stam
points.e: De stam is a five-part artistic artwork or group of statues in Amsterdam-West. It is (partly) applied art. The title refers to two meanings: the tree trunk, and the volksstammen (tribes) who worked here for the growing Amsterdam.

points.name: De Stam
points.e: De stam is a five-part artistic artwork or group of statues in Amsterdam-West. It is (partly) applied art. The title refers to two meanings: the tree trunk, and the volksstammen (tribes) who worked here for the growing Amsterdam.

points.name: De Stam
points.e: De stam is a five-part artistic artwork or group of statues in Amsterdam-West. It is (partly) applied art. The title refers to two meanings: the tree trunk, and the volksstammen (tribes) who worked here for the growing Amsterdam.

points.name: De Titaantjes
points.e: De Titaantjes, or Hommage aan Nescio, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a tribute to the writer Nescio by sculptor Hans Bayens. More statues of writers by Bayens are known: he portrayed Multatuli at the Torensluis, and Aagje Deken and Betje Wolff stand at Nes aan de Amstel.

points.name: De trap
points.e: De trap (2016-2017) is a composite artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Steffen Maas came up with a staircase of bluestone that takes you from one place to another. In his words, "From A to B, from origin to destination, from memory to expectation, from aversion to rapprochement." The staircase itself creates expectation.

points.name: De verdwenen boer
points.e: De verdwenen boer is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. Twenty years after the redesign of Molenwerf from station square to "normal street", the statue De verdwenen boer by Karel Gomes was placed around 2005.

points.name: De Vlam
points.e: De vlam is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue was designed by artist Edith ten Kate (1917-1995), who designed it for the Andreas Ziekenhuis. The statue, made by A. Binder Bronsgieterij, could according to experts be categorised as organic abstract.

points.name: De Vredesraket
points.e: De Vredesraket (also Vredesbeeld 21 november 1981) was a sculpture by the Yugoslav artist Slavomir Miletić, which stood on the Museumplein in Amsterdam from 1981 to 1995.

points.name: De vrijheid van de gedachte
points.e: De vrijheid van de gedachte is a statue by artist Hildo Krop.

points.name: De Wachter
points.e: De wachter is a statue designed by Boris Tellegen in Amsterdam-Zuid, which watches over and waits by a local children's campus. In 2016 the statue was placed in its permanent location on the Antonio Vivaldistraat in Amsterdam-Zuid at the Zuidas.

points.name: De Wereld bleef doof
points.e: Het Monument voor Joodse Dove Oorlogsslachtoffers is a memorial on the Hortusplantsoen in Amsterdam for deaf and hard-of-hearing Jewish victims of the Second World War. It came about on the initiative of the Stichting Dovenshoah and was unveiled on 17 October 2010.

points.name: De werken van barmhartigheid
points.e: De werken van barmhartigheid is a group of statues in Amsterdam-Centrum. Artist Tineke Smith designed a group of statues for the diaconie of the Protestantse Gemeente in Amsterdam at Nieuwe Herengracht 16 (Corvershof), drawing on Matthew 25.

points.name: De Worstelaars
points.e: De worstelaars is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The sculpture was designed by Hans IJdo. He created two (floating) wrestlers in bronze, locked in a fight. One of the wrestlers already lies on his back but holds the arms of the one above him in check. According to some, it stands for wrestling with life.

points.name: Decorative pavement Gravenstraat
points.e: Het Sierklinkerwerk Gravenstraat is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. To view the artwork, you must stare at the ground. For centuries the Gravenstraat, together with the Eggerstraat, has formed the northeastern site boundary of the Amsterdam.

points.name: Demeure 4 (Lanleff)
points.e: Demeure 4 (Lanleff) is an artistic artwork standing in the Siegerpark, Riekerpolder, Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

points.name: Diakenhuismannetje
points.e: Keesje, het diakenhuismannetje is an artwork standing in the Siegerpark, Riekerpolder, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue by Jan Bronner has been part of the sculpture park of the said park since 1998.

points.name: Dikke vrindjes
points.e: Dikke vrindjes is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue stands at the residential care complex for the elderly De Open Hof on Fahrenheitstraat 115 in De Wetbuurt, Watergraafsmeer. The elderly complex had just undergone an extension. In 1985 a statue by Taeke Friso de Jong was placed here.

points.name: DIN 20
points.e: Constructie staal DIN 20 is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The creation by artist André Volten stands on the Wiltzanghlaan (near house number 60). The work is made up of H-profiles. Volten experimented more often with these building components in the 1960s.

points.name: Diversity in bureaucracy
points.e: Diversity in bureaucracy is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artwork consists of two building-high murals by Judith de Leeuw, who was 26 years old at the time. Through the painting she wanted to point to class inequality and hidden racism as opposed to solidarity.

points.name: Diversity in one
points.e: Diversity in one is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord, originally in five parts. In the period from 1983 to 1987, a complex of the former Amsterdamsche Droogdok Maatschappij was changed from shipbuilding area into a residential neighbourhood.

points.name: Dock workers
points.e: Havenwerkers is the name of a group of sandstone statues that sculptor Hildo Krop originally made for placement at the building of the Koninklijke Hollandsche Lloyd in the Oostelijk Havengebied in Amsterdam.

points.name: Doe iets
points.e: Doe iets is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is an installation by Serge Verheugen. It is made of perforated metal angle profiles, which in 2005 were used in the lightly movable scaffold DOEIDOEI for Schiphol, to which an artwork was also attached. It was meant to wave off travellers with dozens of little hands.

points.name: Domicilie
points.e: Domicilie is a multiple artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Artists Wouter de Baat and Dick Simonis were commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam to brighten up the Holendrecht-West neighbourhood with an artwork.

points.name: Door zinloos geweld omgekomen
points.e: Door zinloos geweld omgekomen is one of the smaller war memorials in Amsterdam. The little monument is placed at the entrance of the elderly centre De Flesseman. It consists of a plaque a few centimetres wide and high, with a depth of a few millimetres.

points.name: Drie leeuwtjes
points.e: Drie leeuwtjes, or Leeuwen for short, is a three-part artistic artwork and play element in Amsterdam-Oost. The group of statues is designed by Alice Helenklaken of the artists' group Handle with Care. They are three stone lions, each lying in a different position in the open space belonging to the Leeuwenhoekstraat.

points.name: Drie pylonen
points.e: Drie pylonen is an artistic artwork in Molenwijk, Amsterdam-Noord. The neighbourhood was laid out at the end of the 1960s to a design by architect Klaas Geerts. In 1970 three stone pylons were placed for the Spinnekop flats by artist Ben Guntenaar. Buitenkunst Amsterdam described them as "marking in the landscape" or "gateway".

points.name: Drie schepen van Bierman
points.e: In and along the Dostojevskisingel in Amsterdam-Zuidoost lies a three-part untitled artistic and somewhat architectural artwork. It consists of three partly ruined ships designed by artist Kees Bierman (1936). It was assembled in 1988. In the singel, which functions as a canal, a wooden ship floats or stands, increasingly overgrown by local flora.

points.name: Drie zeilschepen
points.e: Drie zeilschepen is a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

points.name: Droombeeld
points.e: Droombeeld is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a work by Cephas Stauthamer, standing in the northern part of the Frederik Hendrikplantsoen, where it "guards" one of the entrances. It dates from 1965. Little is known about the work: an abstracted animal in bronze with its jaws wide open.

points.name: Dubbel glas
points.e: Dubbel glas is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The work dates from 2011, when a number of buildings on the Van Noordtstraat were thoroughly renovated. Marjet Wessels Boer was then asked to make a design for the glass of the central stairwell. Wessels Boer came up with light-transmitting prints for the glass front of building no. 9.

points.name: Duik in de verbeelding
points.e: Duik in de verbeelding is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work dates from 2008 and is by Mario Molina Espeleta. It is applied to the business building Petersburg on the Frans de Wollantstraat, but it can be seen best as a whole from the entrance to the Funenpark.

points.name: Dwazen denken te beschermen
points.e: Dwazen denken te beschermen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. There are two versions, both by Berend Peter. The artist believed the object should be viewable from all sides without "the story" being lost, so it has no specific front, side or back.

points.name: Eberhard van der Laan
points.e: Eberhard van der Laan is a small artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work by Street Art Frankey came after a commission from pop venue Paradiso on the Weteringschans. That artist, known simply as Frankey, enlivened the Amsterdam streetscape in the early 21st century with all sorts of small art objects.

points.name: Ecologische voetafdruk
points.e: Ecologische voetafdruk is a mural (street painting) in Amsterdam-Noord. What is special about this mural is that it is set horizontally, on the bridge deck of the Elsje Christiaensbrug over the Buiksloterkanaal.

points.name: Een groot teken
points.e: Een groot teken is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

points.name: Een mens van water
points.e: Een mens van water is an artistic artwork and fountain in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue seems to stand out of context. In 2003 the new office of the Amsterdamse Waterleidingbedrijf opened here, in a building designed by Aat van Tilburg.

points.name: Een poort voor Oostpoort, Linnaeusstraat
points.e: Een poort voor Oostpoort, also known as Oostportaal, is a two-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Een transparante grens
points.e: Een transparante grens is a form of applied art in Amsterdam-Oost. In the Indische Buurt four squares meet: Obiplein, Ambonplein, Boniplein and a playground on the Sumatrastraat. The Ambonplein forms the hinge point within them.

points.name: Een vertaling, van de ene taal naar de andere
points.t: Een vertaling, van de ene taal naar de andere
points.e: Een vertaling, van de ene taal naar de andere is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It comes from the hand of conceptual artist Lawrence Weiner. He was commissioned by the University of Amsterdam to make that university more visible in the city.

points.name: Eerbetoon Gliphoeve
points.e: Eerbetoon Gliphoeve is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost on the end gable of the Gravestein flats.

points.name: Eerste steen
points.e: Eerste steen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. During the redevelopment of KNSM-eiland from harbour to residential area, among other things the Albertcomplex (1989-1993) by architect Bruno Albert was built. This housing complex was built around a central square with entrances on the Levantkade and KNSM-laan.

points.name: Eerste steen voor Comeniusmonument
points.e: De Gedenksteen Comenius is a memorial stone set into the pavement of the Valeriusplein, Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies in the middle pavement towards the Het Amsterdams Lyceum. It was a so-called first stone; here it would also be the last stone. The early asylum seeker Jan Amos Comenius was on the run and came to live (and to die) in Amsterdam.

points.name: Energie en tijd
points.e: Energie en tijd is a wall sculpture from 1962 by artist Hans Verhulst. The sculpture of concrete and steel is located on a wall of the Marnixstraat substation bordering the Lauriergracht. The site of the object has been connected with energy since the start of Amsterdam's urban expansions.

points.name: Entree de Borcht
points.e: Entree De Borcht is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. To give the Amstelpark more visibility as an attraction park, the Zuideramstel borough invited five artists to make new entrances. These new entrances and exits had to be both functional and artistic.

points.name: Entree Rozenoord
points.e: Entree Rozenoord is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. To give the Amstelpark more visibility as an attraction park, the Zuideramstel borough invited five artists to make new entrances. These new entrances and exits had to be both functional and artistic.

points.name: Erectus
points.e: Erectus is a group of statues standing in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a creation by Erwin de Vries from 1977, which since 1978 has stood in the inner courtyard of what was then the Gliphoeve flats. That flat was renamed Geldershoofd en Gravestein in 1984 because of its negative reputation.

points.name: Erotica
points.e: Erotica is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Artist Erwin de Vries was commissioned by the municipality of Amsterdam around 1971 to make a sculpture for placement in a small park between the Jan Tooropstraat and the rear of the low-rise flats on the Jan Voermanstraat.

points.name: Europa
points.e: Europa is a statue by Hans Kuyper. The statue dates from around 1995. Since 2005 it has stood in a small park near the Arend Westermanbrug (bridge 186), north-west of the place where the Postjeswetering and Admiralengracht meet. The main road along which the artwork can be seen is called the Postjesweg.

points.name: Familie
points.e: Familie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a two-part group of statues and depicts a family (woman, man, daughter, son). Familie was designed by Paul de Reus. It dates from 2008 and was made on commission from the municipality of Amsterdam or the relevant borough. It stands in the north-western part of the Theo van Goghpark.

points.name: Familie Woezel
points.e: Familie Woezel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The creation by Marijke van Lis, standing in front of the Tjasker flats in Molenwijk, forms a (split) unit together with the Woezel in Zaanhof, Amsterdam-West. Following a larger Woezel (Woezelflat) shown at Floriade 1972 in 1972, the artist explained it.

points.name: Family Ties
points.e: Verwantschappen (Family ties) is an artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos. The group of eleven statues is by artist Serge Verheugen and dates from 2013/2014. Verheugen was inspired by the wood present in the forest.

points.name: Fata Morgana
points.e: Fata morgana is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It stands on a railway bridge over the Ringvaart van de Watergraafsmeer. The statue group was made by artist Iris Le Rütte and dates from 2005; they were unveiled on 9 September of that year.

points.name: Fence Olympiaplein
points.e: Het Hekwerk Olympiaplein is an artistic artwork in the category of applied art in Amsterdam-Zuid. The elongated Olympiaplein in Amsterdam is for the most part used by Sportpark Olympiaplein. This sports park served as a training ground during the 1928 Summer Olympics.

points.name: Ferdinand Domela Nieuwenhuis
points.e: The statue of Domela Nieuwenhuis is an artwork in Amsterdam-West, Spaarndammerbuurt. The statue is a consequence of the placement of the Monument Indië-Nederland, formerly the Van Heutzmonument.

points.name: Fertility
points.e: Vruchtbaarheid is a statue in Amsterdam by artist Jacques Jutte (1930). Since 1970 it has stood in the small park of the residential street Vreedenhaven, along the road Hoekenes, in the Osdorp neighbourhood of the Nieuw-West borough. This work by Jutte is a kind of triptych in geometric bronze forms, which also match in atmosphere.

points.name: Fete galante
points.e: Fête galante is a sculpture by Hans van den Ban from 1997, placed along the Weesperstraat and Nieuwe Kerkstraat in Amsterdam-Centrum. The title would refer to the painting term in which pleasure is the main element. The playfulness was needed because of the austere house and office blocks that rose here after a thorough clearance of the neighbourhood.

points.name: Figuren
points.e: Figuren is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. In the years 1960-1963 a school was built at Krelis Louwenstraat 1 for the Vereniging Hendrick de Keijserschool. It was to provide accommodation for the Uitgebreid Technisch Onderwijs; the school was a design by Arno Nicolaï.

points.name: fish
points.e: Moederste is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is work by Susanne Khalil Yusef (Germany, 1984), child of Palestinian refugees, trained at the St. Joost School of Art & Design. With this work Yusef reflected on the fiftieth anniversary of the House of Orange in the Bellamybuurt.

points.name: Floating gardens (Amsterdam)
points.e: Drijvende Tuinen are a group of five floating gardens in the Oostelijk Havengebied in Amsterdam, designed and built by artist Robert Jasper Grootveld.

points.name: Floating poetry room
points.e: Floating poetry room is an artwork from 2005 in Amsterdam-Oost. It was designed by the American artist Siah Armajani and produced by the Dutch artist Ben Raaijman. The artwork was funded from the art budget of the IJtram project, the construction of tram line 26, administered by the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunsten (AFK).

points.name: Flora
points.e: De lente (colloquially Flora) is an artistic artwork in the Beatrixpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a statue of Flora, goddess of spring. The statue was made with a subsidy from the municipality of Amsterdam, a support project during the interwar period to help artists somewhat during the crisis.

points.name: Fontain Haarlemmerplein
points.e: De Fontein Haarlemmerplein is a fountain placed in/on the Haarlemmerplein in Amsterdam-Centrum. The fountain was placed after a new redesign of the square, following an earlier "touch-up" in the 1970s. Around 2010, after years of new building, a new northern edge was created to a design by architect Dick van Gameren, who thereby created a new northern edge.

points.name: Fontein Hogeweg
points.e: De Fontein Hogeweg is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Fontein Kolenkit
points.e: De Fontein Kolenkit is a fountain in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The fountain was placed in a spirit reflecting the continuous changes in this part of Amsterdam in the 21st century. In the Kolenkitbuurt a lot of buildings have been renovated or demolished and replaced by new construction.

points.name: Fontein met boegbeelden
points.e: Fontein met boegbeelden is the exact description of an artistic artwork standing on the Amsterdam Marineterrein, Kattenburg. The statue was placed thanks to the 1% scheme, under which 1% of the construction costs of new or restored buildings had to be spent on art in public space.

points.name: Fontein Wertheimpark
points.e: Fontein Wertheimpark is an artistic artwork in the Wertheimpark in Amsterdam-Centrum. It consists of a combination of a statue and a fountain. After entrepreneur and philanthropist Abraham Carel Wertheim died in 1897, a committee was formed within a few days to commemorate him, by means of a street named after him and a statue.

points.name: Fortuna
points.e: (Vrouwe) Fortuna is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. In 1949 sculptor Pieter Starreveld made, for the Stoomvaart-Maatschappij Nederland (SMN), the war memorial Zeeman op de uitkijk, which was placed on Java-eiland. Not long afterwards, on the occasion of the SMN's eightieth anniversary, he made the statue Fortuna.

points.name: Fotokijkers-Viewers
points.e: Fotokijkers, or Viewers, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is the work of artist Robin van 't Haar, who in his work often depicted people in their urban surroundings. He believed that this environment (open space) influenced people and therefore influenced the behaviour of those same people.

points.name: Fountain 's-Gravesandeplein
points.e: De Fontein 's-Gravesandeplein is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The 's-Gravesandeplein was almost completely redesigned at the start of the 21st century, with the demolition of older buildings and the subsequent new construction for the Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis.

points.name: Fountain Droogbak
points.e: Fontein Droogbak is a fountain in Amsterdam-Centrum. This small fountain was placed in 2000 to round off the restoration (and conversion) of Droogbak on the street of the same name in Amsterdam. The fountain was designed by architect Simon Sprietsma, working for the Dienst Ruimtelijke Ordening (Dienst Binnenstad).

points.name: Fountain Krugerplein
points.e: De Fontein Krugerplein is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. When the Krugerplein was redesigned around the turn of the century, two artists were asked to design an artwork for public space. Caro Bensca came up with Lady Solid and Peer Veneman with the fountain.

points.name: fragment van een huiskamer
points.e: Fragment van een huiskamer (officially with the addition: reduced to 88%) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a statue from 2001 by Mark Manders, who at that time was working on a series of statues under the heading Zelfportret als gebouw (Self-Portrait as Building).

points.name: Franse bogen
points.e: Parijse bogen is a fictitious title of an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artist Peter Diem had bought these arches from the remains of the Les Halles fish market in Paris, which was demolished in 1971. After restoring them, he gave them to the Gemeente Amsterdam, which placed them at the entrance of the W.H. Vliegenbos on the Meeuwenlaan.

points.name: Friends part 1
points.e: Friends part 1 is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum; the original was called Airhead nr. 1. The artist Nouch first put up this mural in 2019. She had already drawn murals in the form of an airhead (balloon head or balloon creature) on paper, but she also wanted to find them again at a larger scale.

points.name: Future past glory
points.e: Future past glory is a work by Liet Heringa and Maarten van Kalsbeek in Amsterdam-Zuid. The stainless steel statue, 8.5 metres wide and 5.30 metres high, stands in the Beatrixpark. It is a tribute to architect Ko Mulder, who worked at the Dienst der Publieke Werken from 1930 to 1965.

points.name: Gatekeepers Amsterdam
points.e: Gatekeepers is a group of statues in Amsterdam-Oost. The two statues come from the studio of artist Monika Dahlberg, who makes statues from recyclable material. According to Het Parool, her statues have already been found all over the world. Nevertheless, Gatekeepers also regularly go missing.

points.name: Gedenkraam Sociale Dienst Amsterdam
points.e: Het Gedenkraam Sociale Zaken, also known as Bevrijdingsraam, is a memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The window was designed in 1945/1946 by Jan Grégoire for the Gemeentelijke Dienst voor Sociale Zaken in Amsterdam. It was placed in July 1946 in memory of civil servants of that department who lost their lives during the Second World War.

points.name: Gedenksteen Gerrit van der Veen
points.e: De Gedenksteen Gerrit van der Veen is a war memorial and artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The tableau is the work of Fred Carasso, who designed it in memory of artist and resistance fighter Gerrit van der Veen. Both had studios in the studio houses on the Zomerdijkstraat in the Rivierenbuurt.

points.name: Gedenksteen Jan Verleun en Gerard Steen
points.t: Gedenksteen Jan Verleun en Gerard Steen
points.e: The memorial stone for Jan Verleun and Gerard Steen is a war memorial in Amsterdam. Jan Verleun and Gerard Steen (Dordrecht, 26 January 1925 - Sint Pancras, 15 April 1945), both parishioners of the Boomkerk, were two soldiers who died during the Second World War. In memory of the two, sculptor Willem IJzerdraat made a memorial stone.

points.name: Gedenksteen voor het voormalig Huis van Bewaring
points.t: Gedenksteen voor het voormalig Huis van Bewaring
points.e: De Gedenksteen voor het voormalig Huis van Bewaring, also called Gedenksteen 4 mei, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The sculpture was designed by architect Pieter Zaanen, who was responsible for the new building around 1990 at the Max Euweplein.

points.name: Gedenksteen voor verzetsman Anton de Kom
points.e: The memorial stone for Anton de Kom in the Nieuwe Kerk in Amsterdam was unveiled in 2022. Anton de Kom received increasing attention in the years before 2022 for his resistance during the Second World War, but also for his struggle against colonialism and racism through his book Wij slaven van Suriname.

points.name: Gedenkteken De Leeuw
points.e: Gedenkteken De Leeuw consists of a relief set into a blind gable section on the Anne Frankstraat, Amsterdam-Centrum. The association building De Leeuw was located at Valkenburgerstraat 149.

points.name: Gedenkteken Gerard Reve
points.e: Het Gedenkteken Gerard Reve is a memorial in Amsterdam-West. The three-part artistic artwork (2006) in memory of Gerard Reve is by Margriet Kemper. For the Waterspiegelplein she came up with a fairly unobtrusive monument that blends entirely into its surroundings. The first part consists of a wooden bench, which offers a view to the east.

points.name: Gedenkteken Ir. Jakoba Mulder
points.e: Het Gedenkteken Ir. Jakoba Mulder is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work can be seen on the Ir. Jakoba Mulderplein; both are named after city architect Ko Mulder. The sculpture consists of three parts. First there is a round base plate of granite, which rises at an angle out of the ground.

points.name: Gedenkteken Joodse Musici
points.e: The Gedenkteken Joodse Musici is a monument placed in the Koninklijk Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. It is located on the first floor behind the Grote Zaal, behind the organ and near a portrait bust of Gustav Mahler. Interior architect Evelyne Merkx and graphic designer René Knip made the monument.

points.name: Gedenkteken Lancaster
points.e: The Gedenkteken Lancaster is a memorial placed in December 2022 at Metrostation Amsterdam-Noorderpark. On 20 December 1942 an Avro Lancaster (R5512) crashed into the Volewijkspark near Nieuwendammerham. It was returning from a bombing raid on Duisburg in the Ruhr area when German anti-aircraft fire hit it over Amsterdam-Noord.

points.name: Gedenkteken Maria Montessori
points.e: The Gedenkteken Maria Montessori is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue from 1953 was made by Gerarda Rueter. The commission came from the municipality of Amsterdam, which at the time customarily commissioned art to be delivered. The statue was due to be finished by September 1953.

points.name: Gedenkteken Muiderpoortstation
points.e: The Gedenkteken Muiderpoortstation, also known as the Deportatiemonument Muiderpoortstation, is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost at the Oosterspoorplein. It was placed in 2002 in memory of the more than 11,000 Jews who were first deported from Station Amsterdam Muiderpoort to the transit camp Westerbork.

points.name: Gedenkteken voormalig Nederlands-Israëlisch jongensweeshuis
points.e: The Gedenkteken voormalig Nederlands-Israëlisch jongensweeshuis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The orphanage was known as the Joods Jongenshuis. It served that purpose until 1977, although in its last years it had various other uses, such as a social workshop. It was razed to make way for the construction of the Stopera.

points.name: Gedenkteken W.A. Froger
