points.e: The Gedenkteken W.A. Froger is a memorial in honour of engineer Willem Anthonie Froger, one of the men behind the construction of the Noordzeekanaal. Froger was involved while he was still a professional soldier in the engineers. He died in 1883 as an independent architect, when one would have expected a memorial marker for his contribution to the canal.

points.name: Genius van Amsterdam
points.e: Genius van Amsterdam is an artwork on the border of Amsterdam-Zuid and Amsterdam-Oost. When the construction of the Berlagebrug over the Amstel, led by Hendrik Petrus Berlage (aesthetics) and Wichert Arend de Graaf (engineering), was definitively announced in 1927, the name Hildo Krop also came up.

points.name: Gestold water
points.e: Gestold water is an artwork and applied art at Oostoever Sloterplas in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. When the Oostoever neighbourhood was laid out from the decommissioned West sewage treatment plant, art was also integrated into it. The initiators were the Amsterdamse Fonds voor de Kunst and Stadsdeel Nieuw-West.

points.name: Getekend
points.e: Getekend is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. The artwork, from the category of optical illusion, was placed in 2006 by the artist Hans van der Pas.

points.name: Gevallen Engel
points.e: Sublime symbols is a series of sculptures by Peter van de Locht, started in 1979. One of them stands in Amsterdam-West. The artwork stands on the south-eastern wing of bridge 347. The bridge is located on the Haarlemmerweg, where it meets the De Wittenkade, on the bank of the Kostverlorenvaart.

points.name: Giant pink glasses
points.e: Giant pink glasses (Dutch: Gigantische roze bril) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artist Daniella Rubinovitz wanted people to see the world differently, not in the open field but through a see-through frame, in this case a large pink pair of glasses. It could bring a person to a different insight.

points.name: Goede verzorging van een zwerfsteen
points.e: Goede verzorging van een zwerfsteen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. This 1988 creation by Peter Breed consists of a granite plinth standing in the water, with a metal water pipe from which water flows onto an erratic boulder connected to the plinth.

points.name: Gold in your mind, gold in your feet
points.t: Gold in your mind, gold in your feet
points.e: Gold in your mind, gold in your feet is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue by the artist Mirjam Janse is a gift from the artist to Stadsdeel Westerpark. That district had no money, so the artist had to finance the statue alone; the district only provided the location.

points.name: Golf
points.e: Golf is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue, whose maker is as yet unknown, is built into the entrance to an education complex on De Klencke. A school stood here from the 1960s, which was demolished in the early 1980s.

points.name: Golf met drukveer
points.e: Golf met drukveer is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The creation by Gérard Leonard van den Eerenbeemt has stood since 1980 on a grass field between the Westlandgracht and the Heemstedestraat. The grass field lies south of the Westlandgrachtschutsluis.

points.name: Grachtenvlinder
points.e: Grachtenvlinder is a temporary artistic and structural artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. During the work on the bridges in the Oranje Loper, auxiliary bridges had to be placed. These were needed not only to keep foot and bicycle traffic possible, but also because all kinds of cables were rerouted from the main bridge.

points.name: Grafmonument van Willem Breuker
points.e: The grave monument of Willem Breuker is located at the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery in Amsterdam-Oost. The grave of the musician Willem Breuker is accompanied by a sculpture by Marinus Boezem. The two artists first met in the 1970s, when Breuker visited the Nieuwe Muziek Zeeland festival in Zeeland.

points.name: Graft, Amsterdam
points.e: Graft 1-5 (Dutch: ent) is a group of sculptures by James Beckett in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Granietblokken Jacoba van Tongerenbrug
points.e: Granietblokken Jacoba van Tongerenbrug is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The Jacoba van Tongerenbrug, named after Jacoba van Tongeren, was delivered in 1953 as Bridge 602. The aesthetic architect of the fixed bridge was Piet Kramer; the technical part came from the office of the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

points.name: Grenspaal
points.e: Grenspaal, also known as Zuildragende schildpad (column-bearing turtle) or Monument van Jacob Israël de Haan, is a statue in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was made by Hans 't Mannetje. The statue stands at the start of the Jodenbreestraat, at the point where the road begins at the Sint Anthoniesluis.

points.name: Groot Landschap
points.e: Groot Landschap is an artwork in the Sloterpark in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. This large Cor-Ten steel statue is the work of visual artist Wessel Couzijn and was executed by bronze founder Mart Joosten. The sheet-steel statue measures 22 by 12 by 3.5 metres and was placed here in 1974 on a mound built for it.

points.name: Grote man, kleine man
points.e: Grote man, kleine man is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artist Stephan Balkenhol designed for the M.J. Granpré Molièreplein in the new-build neighbourhood Noordenhof a statue in which a small man climbs up the left leg of a large man. Balkenhol's oeuvre is full of images of people, but in enlarged form.

points.name: Gyroscoop
points.e: Gyroscoop is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work, based on a gyroscope, was placed in 1995 on top of the offices of Stadsdeel Zeeburg. The artist is Jos Kokke, who was inspired by the work that for a century took place in the Entrepothaven, where ships came and went.

points.name: H.P. Berlage
points.e: The statue of H.P. Berlage is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Haak en oog
points.e: Haak en oog is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue was designed by Wendela Gevers Deynoot and dates from 1991. It stands in front of the Gein neighbourhood centre, which was completed at that time. The address of the building is Wisseloord 83, where Wisseloord crosses the Westbroekstraat. The statue is made of black lacquered steel.

points.name: Haan op zuil
points.e: Haan op zuil is a sandstone sculpture in Westerpark in Amsterdam-West. It is a classically styled statue by Han Rädecker. Little is known about its background. The sculptor is said to have received the commission in 1955; the statue was placed in late summer 1958. It was the first statue placed in the park, and several more followed.

points.name: Handen
points.e: Handen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a sculpture created by the artist Willem Reijers (1910-1958). Handen can be seen on the Wibautstraat; the artwork suddenly protrudes from the almost completely flat rear facade of the Cygnus Gymnasium, formerly the Eerste Christelijke LTS Patrimonium.

points.name: Hans Snoek-fontein
points.e: The Hans Snoekfontein is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The fountain is named after Hans Snoek, founder of the Scapino Ballet, who contributed financially through a legacy to the construction of the fountain and the renovation of the square. Other contributions came from American Hotel and Holland Casino. The whole was unveiled on 12 June 2006.

points.name: Hare table
points.e: Hazentafel is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, on the Dufaystraat. The artist Iris Le Rütte made a neighbourhood table around 2006 in the category of optical illusion. At first glance three hares carry a tabletop. At a second look it turns out that the hares, in the pose they are shown in, could never lift the tabletop; it hangs from their legs.

points.name: Heilig Hartbeeld
points.e: The Heilig Hartbeeld (Sacred Heart statue) is a statue in the Dutch city of Amsterdam.

points.name: Hekwerk De Nederlandsche Bank
points.e: The Hekwerk (railing) of De Nederlandsche Bank was an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The building of De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) at Westeinde 1 has an overhang (an overhanging facade element) where the ground floor meets the first floor. Above and below that overhang, glass is the most widely used material.

points.name: Hekwerk Hudsonhof
points.e: The Hekwerk Hudsonhof in Amsterdam-West is the alternative name for an untitled artwork by Narcisse Tordoir. In 1993 Tordoir's Hekwerk Barcelonaplein was built into the Albert complex by Bruno Albert on the Barcelonaplein.

points.name: Hekwerk van de Hermitage Amsterdam
points.e: The Hekwerk van de Hermitage Amsterdam is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. When the Amstelhof building was converted from a care centre into the Hermitage Amsterdam, the architecture firm around Hans van Heeswijk was brought in to guide the conversion and redesign.

points.name: Hemels juweel
points.e: Hemels juweel is an artwork from 1998 in Amsterdam-Oost. For the redevelopment of Java Island from harbour area to residential neighbourhood, architect and urban planner Sjoerd Soeters developed not only the layout but also designed a number of buildings. Several of his buildings were then decorated with an artwork.

points.name: Hemelwater
points.e: Hemelwater is applied art in Amsterdam-Oost. Erick de Lyon designed it for the 140-metre-long front facade of two combined new-build complexes at Vrolikstraat 331-395 in Amsterdam (1999). The BAG viewer gives 1999 as the completion date. The rainwater downpipes were originally meant to be hidden behind the facade.

points.name: Herman Heijermans
points.e: The bust of Herman Heijermans is an artwork in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: Het Geheim en het Bewijs
points.e: Het geheim en het bewijs is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue from 2010 stands at the spot where the Abcouderpad crosses the Anna Blamansingel.

points.name: Het Gezin
points.e: Het gezin is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The maker of the relief, Nico Onkenhout, gave his vision of the families who settled around 1955 in the new-build homes by architect Commer de Geus on the De Perronstraat. Stair-access apartments were built there, suitable for new small or starting families. Six small blocks were set out.

points.name: Het Gouden Kruis
points.e: Het gouden kruis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Following a number of building projects in Reigersbos in the 1980s, an art competition was held. Art in public space could be placed for 1 percent of the building costs. Artist Han Goan Lim won the competition with his Gouden kruis, working title Double cross.

points.name: Het Palenhuis
points.e: Het Palenhuis, or Ode aan de heipaal, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It was unveiled in September 2021 on the north-western side of the junction of the Zuiderzeeweg and the IJburglaan, north of the entrance and exit of the Piet Heintunnel. The municipality of Amsterdam began in 2018 laying out and preparing the so-called Sluisbuurt for building.

points.name: Het toverbos aan De Rijpstraat
points.e: Het toverbos aan De Rijpstraat (the magic forest on De Rijpstraat) is a house-high mural on the building at De Rijpstraat 125 in Amsterdam-West. Rijpstraat 125 is the first building with an odd house number on De Rijpstraat.

points.name: Het westen ontvangt en ontmoet 't oosten
points.t: Het westen ontvangt en ontmoet 't oosten
points.e: Het westen ontvangt en ontmoet 't oosten is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost, Oosterpark. It is a totem of galvanised steel with various chakras. It was made by Theo Niermeijer and dates from 1970. Niermeijer described the statue as "symbolic representations of human energy centres".

points.name: Heuvelreeks
points.e: The Heuvelreeks is a partly deteriorated artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artist Jaap van Hunen made seven retaining walls for the Molenwijk neighbourhood, placed around hills along the bicycle path (which is also called Molenwijk) to keep the hills alive and emphasise them. The series dates from 1975-1977 and is made of gravel concrete.

points.name: Hollandse Tuin
points.e: The Hollandse Tuin is a 19th-century monumental garden within the Amsterdam zoo Artis. In the garden stands a monument by sculptor Bart van Hove.

points.name: Home sweet home (fence)
points.e: Home sweet home is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It falls into the category of applied art. The Bijlmerpark was laid out around 1977 and was re-arranged in the years 2009 under the lead of Francine Houben of Mecanoo. In both the southern and northern parts a section was (again) reserved and laid out as a sports ground.

points.name: Homeless Jesus
points.e: Jezus als dakloze (English: Homeless Jesus) is an artwork by Timothy Schmalz that has been placed in more than a hundred cities around the world since 2013.

points.name: Hommage
points.e: Hommage is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artist Jos Willems paid tribute to the history of the Entrepothaven in the Eastern Harbour area. The statue consists of a sturdy anvil of Cor-Ten steel, with a bronze bollard placed at an angle on top of it.

points.name: Hommage aan Paradjanov
points.e: Hommage aan Paradzjanov is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Nieuwe Pijp, on the Vredeskerkplein. The artwork by Thom Puckey was placed on commission from the municipality of Amsterdam, which, at the request of the Vredeskerk, specified that a water element had to be incorporated into the artwork.

points.name: Hondje van Linda van Boven
points.e: Hondje is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The official body that manages art in public space has little information on this work: "Bronzen hondje op een kademuurtje van de Erasmusgracht" (bronze little dog on a quay wall of the Erasmusgracht). The site Buitenbeeldinbeeld also lists no details.

points.name: Hoofd
points.e: Hoofd is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a statue by Eddy Gheress from around 1995, worked out in red granite.

points.name: Hoogovenarbeider
points.e: De Hoogovenarbeider is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue from 1970 is by Wilfried Put. Put gave his bronze vision of a worker at the Koninklijke Hoogovens in Velsen. He depicted a worker in overalls and gloves. In his hands is a rod with which he had to stir the hot mass.

points.name: Hope
points.e: Hope is a statue by Pieter Ceizer. Ceizer (Amsterdam, 1982) grew up around or in the Museumkwartier; as a child he learned to swim in the Zuiderbad, for example. He was regularly to be found on the Museumplein, where he saw alternative art (skateboard halfpipe, graffiti, etc.) come and go. He wanted that too.

points.name: Horizontale compositie
points.e: Horizontale compositie is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The municipality of Amsterdam asked the artist Henk Zweerus for a statue oriented horizontally for placement in the Leidsebosje. Zweerus had already made a design drawing in 1954; the announcement with a photo in De Telegraaf drew unfriendly comments.

points.name: Hub Holendrecht
points.e: The Wapen van Holendrecht, pars pro toto for Hub Holendrecht, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The Holendrechtplein, dating from the 1970s, received a makeover in the early 2010s. The shopping centre in the northern part was extended, and the southern part was also tackled.

points.name: Huil van de Wolff
points.e: Huil van de Wolff is an interactive artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was conceived by composer Martijn Padding in collaboration with Johan van der Kreij (programmer and sonologist) and René Bakker (instrument maker). They wanted to keep alive the memory of horn player and concert organiser Jan Wolff.

points.name: Huygenika
points.e: Huygenika is a mural in Amsterdam-West. Huygenika is a portmanteau of the two subjects of the painting: the scientist Constantijn Huygens and the painting Guernica by Pablo Picasso from 1937.

points.name: I am at Home
points.e: I am at home is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The Latvian artist Asnate Bočkis made the artwork for Homo urbanus - Homo sapiens. This statue exhibition partly grew out of the collaboration that Amsterdam has with the Latvian capital Riga.

points.name: I amsterdam Museumplein
points.e: I amsterdam was an attraction that from 2005 appeared in various places in Amsterdam. It consisted of large red and white letters forming the words I amsterdam in Avenir font (where the a and m are still joined together). The words were chosen in 2004 as successor to the slogan Amsterdam has it.

points.name: I don't wa$te my time
points.e: I don't waste my time (graphically: I don't wa$te my time) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist Selwyn Senatori (born 1973) made an enlarged replica of his pedal bin in his studio. In doing so he did not leave out the dent. The theme is Time=money (time is the ultimate luxury).

points.name: IAmsterdam
points.e: I amsterdam Sloterplas is a variant on the I amsterdam theme, placed in July 2016 on the south bank of the Sloterplas, near the Cornelis Lelylaan.

points.name: If walls could speak
points.e: If walls could speak is a ten-part artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. After renovation of five low-rise apartment blocks on the Platanen- and Olmenweg in Amsterdam-Oost, murals were placed in May 2019 on the ten almost gable-end facades of those blocks.

points.name: If you know, you know/5713
points.e: If you know, you know/5713 (Als je het weet, weet je het) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West by Narges Mohammadi, Zeinab El Bouni and the youth department of art institution De Appel. The diptych was unveiled on 12 October 2024.

points.name: Ik speel in de stad met alles wat er bestaat
points.t: Ik speel in de stad met alles wat er bestaat
points.e: Ik speel in de stad met alles wat er bestaat is a mural painted on the blind gable walls of the Tuinstraat in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: In between the gap
points.e: In between the gap is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is applied art: a bird-watching hide designed by Dimitra Chrysovergi from Greece, a student at the Gerrit Rietveld Academie. It is one of a set of three bird hides; the others are 270 degrees and Amfibion (they stand far apart).

points.name: Individualiteit tegenover collectiviteit, Amsterdam
points.e: Individualiteit tegenover collectiviteit (Individualism vs collectivism) is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is a full-width facade mural by Munir de Vries, who has also made murals elsewhere in the city and in Utrecht.

points.name: Industrieel monument
points.e: Industrieel monument is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It consists of a former railway platform with a foreman's hut and a wagon. It is a creation of (Atelier) Joep van Lieshout, placed in public space on the Cruquiusweg in the Eastern Harbour area.

points.name: Innerlijke kleur
points.e: Innerlijke kleur is a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The mural dates from 2013 and was painted on a blind wall in the Paul Scholtenstraat.

points.name: Islanded
points.e: Islanded is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue is by the artist Anneke de Witte, a graduate of the Koninklijke Academie (KAKV) in 's-Hertogenbosch.

points.name: J.F. Kennedy
points.e: The bust of John F. Kennedy is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bust comes from the hands of the artist Renze Hettema. It stands at the intersection of the President Kennedylaan and the Maasstraat. The bronze head of John F. Kennedy stands on a limestone column, and the whole rests on a concrete slab.

points.name: Jacob van Lennep
points.e: The statue for Jacob van Lennep is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It came about on the initiative of Marita Mathijsen, who wished to commemorate Jacob van Lennep not as a writer and state advocate, but as the initiator of drinking water in Amsterdam.

points.name: Jan Willem Pieneman's tomb
points.e: The grave monument of Jan Willem Pieneman at the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery in the Dutch city of Amsterdam is a national monument (rijksmonument).

points.name: Johan Cruijff Memorial Monument
points.e: Gedenkteken Johan Cruijff is an artwork in the form of a memorial. In the Amsterdam neighbourhood of Watergraafsmeer, various artistic and architectural artworks commemorate the footballer Johan Cruijff.

points.name: Jonas en de walvis
points.e: Jonas en de walvis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sculptor Nic Jonk made this bronze statue on a concrete plinth in 1968; it is signed and dated. In 1976 it was included in a sculpture route by Stichting Beeldende Kunst running from the Dam along the Damrak. At that time it stood on the Beursplein.

points.name: Jongen met haan
points.e: Jongen met haan is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Ruth Brouwer made a bronze statue on a concrete plinth for the Montessorischool on Hoekenes, showing a boy playfully holding a rooster. The statue is sometimes seen as a reaction to the 1953 Gedenkteken Maria Montessori by Gerarda Rueter in the Corellistraat, Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Jordaan Oproer
points.e: The Monument Jordaanoproer, also known as Eenheid de sterkste keten (Unity is the strongest chain), is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The monument dates from 1987, was made by Sofie Hupkens and stands on the Noordermarkt, the square belonging to the Noorderkerk.

points.name: Jordaanbewoners 1940-1945
points.e: The Oorlogsgedenkteken omgekomen Jordaanbewoners is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bronze plaque, set in relief, is attached to the southern facade of the Noorderkerk in Amsterdam. The maker and designer is Ezechiël Jacob Hoek. It refers to all residents of the Amsterdam Jordaan neighbourhood who died in the Second World War.

points.name: Juicy Light
points.e: Juicy light is a set of six art objects placed in Amsterdam Oud-West. The 'statue' consists of six lighting units hanging above the Ten Katemarkt, that is, in the Ten Katestraat.

points.name: Justus van Maurikbank
points.e: The Justus van Maurikbank is an artwork and memorial bench in Amsterdam-Oost. It commemorates the then-popular writer Justus van Maurik jr. and was unveiled in 1907.

points.name: Kaarttableaus Amsterdamse Bos
points.e: The Kaarttableaus Amsterdamse Bos (map tableaux) consist of a number of maps set into the Amsterdamse Bos.

points.name: Kabouter
points.e: The Kabouterstandbeeld is a form of public art in Amsterdam-Centrum. The little statue was made as a reminder of the gnome movement, which had its Magies Sentrum (experience centre) on the Spui. Still standing there is Het Lieverdje by Carel Kneulman, which has been knocked over several times but always rises again.

points.name: Kabouterhuis-hek
points.e: The Kabouterhuis-hek is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It consists of a two-dimensional rendering of a gnome village, cut by laser from 10 mm thick Cor-Ten steel.

points.name: Kampvuur
points.e: Camp Fire is an artwork in Amstelveen. The artificial campfire is a creation of the artist Wilhelmus "Pim" Vlug, an artist and DJ born in Gouda on 15 February 1962. He trained at the Gerrit Rietveld Academie. He made Camp Fire for the Amsterdam Light Festival, version 3; it was placed at the Hortus Botanicus.

points.name: Kapkar/GTO-B10
points.e: Kapkar/GTO-B10 is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a statue by Frank Havermans from 2019. Havenaar was asked by the art event "Play Station Sloterdijk" (28 June 2019 to 3 November 2019) to design a statue in connection with the building frenzy around Station Amsterdam Sloterdijk and Rijksweg 10 (Ringweg-West).

points.name: Kariatidenzuil
points.e: The Kariatidenzuil is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The sculptor Joost Barbiers made his version of a column with caryatids around 1984. In antiquity these caryatids served as the column; in the work of Joost Barbiers they form only a small part.

points.name: Kattenburger Triumphal Arch
points.e: The Triomfboog van Kattenburg (English: Kattenburger Triumphal Arch) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The triumphal arch is built into an underpass in an apartment block on the Kattenburgerstraat leading to the Kattenburgerkruisstraat. The artwork is placed on the six pillars in that underpass and consists of twelve parts.

points.name: Kazemat en kogels
points.e: Kazemat en kogels is a chosen title for a two-part artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Until the mid-1980s the Wittenburgervaart was a waterway running between factory grounds. The industry there was still largely related to shipbuilding, which thrived here for years.

points.name: Keeping watch above the flowers
points.e: Keeping watch above the flowers is an artwork by Richard John Jones in Amsterdam-Zuid. It stands among the benches on the Beethovenplein, which is surrounded by a series of buildings. Buildings on the square are in use by the Sint-Nicolaaslyceum, the law firm Stibbe and AkzoNobel.

points.name: Kennisoverdracht
points.e: Kennisoverdracht is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It depicts a schoolmaster and three of his pupils. Two of the pupils appear to be bent under a row of books.

points.name: Kissing Couple XXXL
points.e: The Kissing Couple XXXL (Kussend Paar) is an artwork in Westpoort, Amsterdam. It is a work by Saske van der Eerden.

points.name: Klimmuur Ookmeer
points.e: De Klimmuur Dr. Meurerlaan is an architectural and artistic artwork. It is an example of applied art: an open-air climbing wall from 1988-1991, designed by the artist Boudewijn Payens, who is himself a mountaineer. The wall consists of two concrete triangles resting obliquely against each other.

points.name: Klotsende golven
points.e: Mono No Aware II is a mural in central Amsterdam, made by the artist Mick La Rock in 2023.

points.name: Kogelbron
points.e: De Kogelbron is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The work is a creation of the German artist Christian Tobin. Christian Tobin, who was then still called Christian Mayer, has made this kind of stone (German: Kugelbrunnen; English: Floating spheres) since 1983. The first, titled Oblio, is in Munich.

points.name: Kogelbron Oostenburgerpark
points.e: De Kogelbron is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work is a creation of the German artist Christian Tobin. Christian Tobin, who was then still called Christian Mayer, has made this kind of stone (German: Kugelbrunnen; English: Floating spheres) since 1983. The first, titled Oblio, is in Munich.

points.name: Kolommen
points.e: Opengewerkte kolom is a fictitious name for an untitled artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Kompas
points.e: Het kompas is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It consists of a mosaic by Fabrice Hünd; it is one of his four mega-mosaics in Amsterdam (data 2018). In 2006 he applied thousands of small stones and shards to a small outbuilding on the Marie Heinekenplein, which looked rather forlorn and had fallen victim to all kinds of vandalism.

points.name: Koningin Emmamonument
points.e: The Monument koningin Emma, in memory of Queen Emma, stands on the Emmaplein in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Willemsparkbuurt. The statue was designed by sculptor Lambertus Zijl (1866-1947) and unveiled in 1938.

points.name: koningin Wilhelmina
points.e: Koningin Wilhelmina is an artwork standing on the Koningin Wilhelminaplein in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue was made by Nico Onkenhout and was commissioned around 1967 by the Confectiecentrum (garment trade centre), later renamed World Fashion Centre. The Confectiecentrum had been spread across the city and began to centralise around this square.

points.name: Kosmos
points.e: Kosmos is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, Vondelpark. Kosmos is a statue created by Wim van Hoorn. It was made in 1969-1970 and dates from the period when the artist was interested in the cosmos after Neil Armstrong set foot on the Moon. It consists of a bronze rhombus with cut-outs.

points.name: Kostwinner
points.e: Kostwinner, also known as Drie generaties, is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. The statue by Constance Wibaut stands in a (closed-off) inner courtyard between two apartment blocks with stair-access flats, built on the Granidastraat and the Gulden Winckelstraat. The Leeuwendalerspad, which once ran through, passes the opening on the south side of the block.

points.name: Kreukel (Karin Colen)
points.e: Kreukel is a temporary artwork on the border between Amsterdam-Centrum and Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The boundary between the two districts is formed by the Singelgracht, which here is spanned by bridge 167, named the Rijckerbrug, by architect Piet Kramer and the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

points.name: Kruis
points.e: Kruis is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Little is known about the statue. It was made around 1979 by the artist Michel Somers and placed by the Dalsteinmetrobrug on the Oostlijn. The original was a light object of perspex and steel, with the lighting concealed inside the perspex.

points.name: Kruisteken
points.e: Kruisteken or Kruisbeeld is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Around 1979 the artist Jan Verschoor received a commission from the municipality of Amsterdam. It is an assembly of abstract forms around a vertical axis. With this statue Verschoor sought to find balance.

points.name: Kubus
points.e: The Kubus is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Little is known about the work. It was designed (and perhaps also made) by Arie Jansma. It dates from 1975 and was intended for Shell. Jansma was, however, an amateur artist.

points.name: Kubuspaal
points.e: At the grade-separated junction of Cornelis Lelylaan and Johan Huizingalaan in Amsterdam Nieuw-West stands an untitled artwork. The crossing between the two avenues is handled by an architectural artwork in the form of bridge 705, which carries the Cornelis Lelylaan over the Johan Huizingalaan.

points.name: Kubussen
points.e: In the Bella Vistapark in Amsterdam-Oost stands an untitled artwork. The work comes from André Volten, who was allowed by the Dienst der Publieke Werken to design a statue for a new headquarters of the GEB. Placement and unveiling took place around 23 May 1985. The headquarters at the time stood at Spaklerweg 20.

points.name: Kunstenaarsverzet
points.e: The Monument voor het kunstenaarsverzet 1940-1945 is an artwork and monument in Amsterdam-Centrum. Following the demolition of the Panoramagebouw at Plantage Middenlaan 50, a relatively wide strip of greenery came into being, which in 1963 was given the name Plantage Westermanlaan. It became a small park, without officially receiving that name.

points.name: Kwibukamonument
points.e: The Kwibukamonument is a monument in the Beatrixpark, Amsterdam-Zuid. It refers back to the genocide in Rwanda in 1994. A number of refugees fled to the Netherlands and united in Ibuka-Nederland, but unlike elsewhere in the world they still had no memorial in remembrance of it.

points.name: La demeure humaine
points.e: La demeure humaine is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Leda en de zwaan
points.e: Leda en de zwaan is an artwork in the Erasmuspark in Amsterdam-West. At the request of the municipality of Amsterdam, sculptor Han Rädecker made his version of the mythological story of Leda. He depicted both Leda and Zeus, who had been transformed into a swan.

points.name: Leeuw
points.e: Ontdek de Dam is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work was placed in the last week of August 2021 and is a creation by Street Art Frankey. Frankey places a small artwork in the city of Amsterdam every week, enriching the streetscape with humorous additions to street and facade elements.

points.name: Leeuw en tijger met prooi
points.e: Leeuw met prooi and tijger met prooi (lion with prey and tiger with prey) are two sculptures of French limestone in Amsterdam-Centrum. They stand on either side of the entrance to the former main building of the Artis zoo. The sculptures were originally carved by Jacques Joseph François Verdonck, commissioned by Artis in 1859 and placed in 1861.

points.name: Leeuwen van Zeeburg
points.a: Bart van Hove, Marieke van Diemen
points.e: Leeuwen van Zeeburg is a group of sculptures on either side of the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal. The artwork was "made" by Marieke van Diemen. The group consists of four identical lions standing at the entrance to the canal. These lions date from 2015 but have a history going back to the late 19th century.

points.name: Leeuwen van Zeeburg
points.a: Bart van Hove, Marieke van Diemen
points.e: Leeuwen van Zeeburg is a group of sculptures on either side of the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal. The artwork was "made" by Marieke van Diemen. The group consists of four identical lions standing at the entrance to the canal. These lions date from 2015 but have a history going back to the late 19th century.

points.name: Leidseplein‑Lizards
points.e: Blauw Jan is a collection of bronze statues placed on the Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen. The maker is Hans van Houwelingen.

points.name: Les Pisseurs d'Amsterdam
points.e: Tayouken Piss, or Les pisseurs d'Amsterdam, is a group of statues in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

points.name: Levensboom
points.e: De Levensboom is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a creation of the artist Wim Tap and is said to date from 1989. The artwork consists of two parts. The most striking part is a column of blue bluestone, roughly worked at the lower part as if the column had been eaten away.

points.name: Levensboom
points.e: Levensboom is a sculptural pavilion and artwork in public space on the Ontmoetingseiland in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was designed by architect and artist Angie Abbink and completed in 2015. The steel and glass construction forms a canopy over the existing round stage on the island.

points.name: Liedje van Hans Andreus
points.e: Liedje van Hans Andreus is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The poet Hans Andreus wrote several poems under the title Liedje. The poem contains words he invented himself, such as roekoe- and toedoemeisjes. It is set in lettered pavement tiles in the street tile pattern of the J.W. Siebbeleshof in central Amsterdam.

points.name: Living by Numbers
points.e: The HIV/AIDSmonument is an artwork on De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum that was unveiled on 1 December 2016. The creation by Jean-Michel Othoniel stands on De Ruijterkade, Amsterdam. The initiative for the monument came around 2013 from the Stichting Namen Project Nederland, which asked a number of artists for a monument.

points.name: Lord of the rings
points.e: Lord of the rings is an artwork in the Amsterdamse Bos. The design, within the category of applied art, comes from Buitenom, made up of Minka Haverkorn and Carolien Oomes. The firm designs items for placement in public spaces.

points.name: Love or Generosity
points.e: Love or generosity (Dutch: Liefde of edelmoedigheid) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a five-metre-high statue by the French/American artist Nicole Eisenman, placed on 27 November 2020. The statue is part of the new building for the Rechtbank Amsterdam on the Parnassusweg.

points.name: Love sphinx
points.e: Love sphinx is a sculpture by Carel Kneulman. The statue stands in the Eendrachtspark in Amsterdam Nieuw-West near bridge 619. It dates from around 1974. The Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam exhibited a preliminary study of the statue in 1974 at Museum Fodor.

points.name: Maalstroom nr. 1
points.e: Maalstroom nr. 1 is an artwork in Amsterdam-Westpoort. The artist Thomas Elshuis is an architect by training. He received an inheritance from a friend of the family consisting of 20.000 photos. Since then he has made collages of photos in walls and other constructions.

points.name: Maalstroom nr. 2
points.e: Maalstroom nr. 2 is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artist Thomas Elshuis is an architect by training. He received an inheritance from a friend of the family consisting of 20.000 photos. Since then he has made collages of photos in walls and other constructions.

points.name: Maan over Ameland
points.e: Maan over Ameland is an artistic artwork that stands on an architectural structure in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist Bert de Laaf (Gaspard Albert Jean de Laaf 1932-2014) received a commission in 1969 from the municipality of Amsterdam for an artwork on a new bridge 485 to be built over the Oosterdoksdoorgang.

points.name: Magneten
points.e: Magneten is a statue in Amsterdam-West. The artwork stands on the Koningin Wilhelminaplein (in front of number 16), where it connects with the Schipluidenlaan via bridge 691. The stainless steel sculpture is a design by Lies Maes and was the first Amsterdam commission for this female artist.

points.name: Man en vrouw Rhijnspoorplein
points.t: Man steunend op uitbottende stam en vrouw met vlammend hart
points.e: De man steunend op uitbottende stam and Vrouw met vlammend hart are two artistic artworks standing side by side in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Man op kruk
points.e: De toeschouwer en abstracte vorm is an atypical sculpture group in Westerpark in Amsterdam-West. It is a combined work by Ronald Tolman (figurative) and Liesbeth Pallesen (abstract). Like other parks and small parks in Amsterdam, Westerpark has an extensive art collection.

points.name: Manenschaap
points.e: Manenschaap is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a work by Pieter d'Hont that belongs to the art collection of De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB). The statue dates from 1969, when d'Hont made two versions of a manenschaap.

points.name: Manna
points.e: Manna is a multi-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Colloquially it became known as Halfje gesneden wit. In the period 2018 to 2020 the Meerwaldtplantsoen was renovated. The small park, which has only an unofficial name, is named after resistance fighter Arthur Meerwaldt.

points.name: Mare Nostrum
points.e: Mare Nostrum is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The creation by Barten van Elden and Raymond Hirs dates from around 1988 and consists of three stainless steel zigzag strips lying in a grassland along the Abcouderpad.

points.name: Maria Planeta Citta
points.e: Maria Planeta Citta (1991) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue, a creation by Evert van Kooten Niekerk, was made at the request of the municipality of Amsterdam.

points.name: Maria van de 21e eeuw
points.e: Maria van de 21e eeuw is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue can be found in the publicly accessible reception space of the OLVG-Oost, Oosterpark 9.

points.name: Maria, standing, in Amsterdam
points.e: Staande Maria met Christus is a statue in Amsterdam-Oost. It adorns the facade wall of the Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis on the Eerste Oosterparkstraat. The statue, more than a century old, is the only thing that has survived from the original Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis, which opened in 1898.

points.name: Markering
points.e: Markering is an unofficial name for a sculpture group in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The group of four statues comes from a collaboration between artist Adriaan Rees and children from the neighbourhood of Stadspark Osdorp. The artist himself calls them Kinderbeelden.

points.name: Markttafereel
points.e: Markttafereel consists of two artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four loose statues from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings (a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool) rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

points.name: Mbulu Ngulu
points.e: Mbulu Ngulu is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Alexander Schabracq designed this Mbulu Ngulu, which is the embodiment of the spirit of the dead in Bantu, West Africa. Schabracq himself refers to the Bakota in northeast Gabon. It was placed on a peperbus (advertising column) at the junction of the Czaar Peterstraat and the quay of the Oostenburgergracht.

points.name: Melkfles
points.e: On a small square on the Hercules Seghersstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp, stands an untitled artwork. It is a statue from 1982 by artist Tom Postma. He made it as a memorial to the milk factory (Melkfabriek Holland, Milko) that stood here on the Eerste Jan Steenstraat 10-38.

points.name: Memorial at Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat
points.e: The Monument aan de Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Memorial Dam Square shooting 1945
points.e: A plaque and thirty-two paving stones on the Dam in Amsterdam-Centrum commemorate the victims of the shooting on the Dam on 7 May 1945.

points.name: Memories
points.e: Memories is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a mural by Bastardilla as tall as a house, on the side wall of a housing block between the Burgemeester Röellstraat (house numbers 207-267) and the Nicolaas Ruychaverstraat (house numbers 18-40) in Geuzenveld.

points.name: Mens in beweging
points.e: Mens in beweging is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The creation by artist Peter van den Akker has been placed on the Arent Janszoon Ernststraat in the Buitenveldert district. Van den Akker made the sculpture group commissioned by GGZ Buiten Amstel, which is located in the building with house number 1187.

points.name: Menselijke Energie
points.e: De greep naar het schone consists of two artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. It forms half of a set of four loose statues from the period 1921-1924 by Hildo Krop. In that period two school buildings (a Hogere Burgerschool and a Handelsschool) rose on the Jozef Israëlskade, separated by the Pieter Lodewijk Takstraat.

points.name: Mensen op strand met parasol
points.e: Mensen op strand met parasol is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Artist Jan Spiering designed a statue for a small park on the Botteskerksingel, in which a man shields a woman from the sunrays with a parasol. Almost nothing else is known about the work.

points.name: Mercurius en Psyche
points.e: Hide and see(k) is a work of applied art in Amsterdam-Zuid. The work consists of a fountain designed by the Danish artist Jeppe Hein. Hein designed more fountains, which found their place scattered across the world.

points.name: Microben
points.e: Microben (ook wel Microbe) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. Artist Pauline Wiertz designed a set of twelve round hardstone tiles in 2003 for the WG-Plein, named after the Wilhelmina Gasthuis, which was located here between 1891 and 1983.

points.name: Minerva
points.e: Minerva is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, made between 1929 and 1931 by Jan Havermans.

points.name: Minervapassage
points.e: De Minervapassage is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is the pedestrian tunnel under Station Amsterdam Zuid, which connects the Zuidplein and the Gustav Mahlerplein. It was named after the Minervalaan.

points.name: Mirakelkolom
points.e: De Mirakelkolom is a column on the Rokin in the Dutch capital Amsterdam, erected as a memorial to the Heilige Stede, a church building that formerly stood on the Rokin. The word 'mirakel' refers to the Miracle of Amsterdam, which is said to have taken place in 1345.

points.name: Mirror, Mirror
points.e: Mirror, mirror is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Westpoort. The Arlandabrug is a structure on the Rijksweg 10 over what until 1985 was the Amsterdam-Haarlem railway line. When that was removed here, it became a tunnel for pedestrians, cyclists and trams. That relatively long underpass was felt to be unsafe.

points.name: Mirroring Cube
points.e: Sight point (for Leo Castelli) is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artwork is a creation of the American artist Richard Serra (1938-2024). The statue grew out of a competition around 1972 announced by Wesleyan University in Middletown (Connecticut).

points.name: Missing numbers
points.e: Missing numbers is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Mobiles
points.e: On the eastern bank of the Amstel, in Amsterdam-Oost, stands an untitled artwork. The work stands where the pedestrian area of the Amstelboulevard meets the cycle path of the Omval. The artwork consists of two rotating arms standing on two stake frames along the cycle path of the Amstelboulevard.

points.name: Modern meisje met de parel
points.e: Meisje met de parel is a mural in the Dutch city of Amsterdam by Roelof Schierbeek (graffiti name Beyond) from 2023.

points.name: Moeder Aarde
points.e: Moeder Aarde is a sculpture by sculptor Hildo Krop from the 1920s that has stood in the Tweede Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam since 1958. In 2016 it was replaced by a replica due to serious weathering damage. The statue is said to date from 1926 and is carved from French limestone.

points.name: Moeder en kind
points.e: Moeder en kind, also known as De zorg, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a statue carved from French limestone by Han Wezelaar, placed between September and December 1939 on the Euterpestraat, which was renamed the Gerrit van der Veenstraat on 18 May 1945.

points.name: Monument aan de Marnixstraat, Amsterdam
points.e: The Oorlogsmonument Marnixstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. It stands next to the DeLaMar on the Marnixstraat 404.

points.name: Monument Bos en Lommer
points.e: The Monument 1940-1945 is a war memorial in the Bos en Lommer district of Amsterdam-West. A statue by sculptress Gerarda Rueter (1904-1993) stands here. It is known by many names, including Zittende vrouw, Zittende figuur, Monument 1940-1945, Monument aan de Bos en Lommerweg and Herdenkingsmonument zittende vrouw.

points.name: Monument Burgemeester Tellegen
points.e: The Monument Burgemeester Tellegen is a monument in Amsterdam-Zuid. Jan Willem Cornelis Tellegen was director of "Bouw- en Woningtoezicht" in Amsterdam from 1901, and mayor from 1915 until his death in 1921.

points.name: Monument C.J. van Houten & Zoon
points.e: The Gedenkteken Van Houten & Zn is a municipal monument in the Dutch town of Weesp. Staff presented the memorial in 1928 to mark the 100th anniversary of the firm C. J. van Houten & Zoon. It stands on the corner of Hugo de Grootlaan and G.J. van Houtenlaan/Groeneweg, in Zeerust park by the care home Oversingel.

points.name: Monument De Waarheid
points.e: Monument De Waarheid is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a monument in memory of the staff of De Waarheid, which was distributed illegally from the start of the Second World War. De Waarheid was at that time connected to the Communist Party of the Netherlands. The idea arose at a gathering of Jong en oud verzet.

points.name: Monument Haarlemmerweg
points.e: The Monument aan de Haarlemmerweg is a monument to war victims, placed on the Haarlemmerweg in Amsterdam Nieuw-West between the footbridges and cycle bridges Burgemeester Eliasstraat and Burgemeester Fockstraat.

points.name: Monument Henri Viotta
points.e: The Monument Henri Viotta is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Monument Joods Verzet
points.e: The Monument Joods Verzet 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood since 1988 on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, on the side of the Stopera. It was erected in memory of all Jewish resistance members who perished in the Second World War.

points.name: Monument leven en vrijheid
points.e: The Monument leven en vrijheid is a memorial on the Ceramplein in Amsterdam-Oost. For years, celebrations of the Second World War were held in the Amsterdam Indische Buurt near a freedom tree standing on that square. In 1957 a tile was placed near that freedom tree.

points.name: Monument Marineterrein
points.t: Monument ter herdenking van in de Tweede Wereldoorlog gevallen oud-kwekelingen
points.e: The Monument ter herdenking van in de Tweede Wereldoorlog gevallen oud-kwekelingen is a monument in Amsterdam-Centrum. It came about on the initiative of the "Vereeniging van oud-kwekelingen van de Kweekschool voor de Zeevaart" in Amsterdam.

points.name: Monument Rozenoord
points.e: Monument Rozenoord is a commemorative monument in Amsterdam-Zuid from 2015, in memory of those shot by firing squad during the Second World War at the execution site Rozenoord. A monument (memorial stone and flagpole) has stood at the site of the execution itself for years. However, the dead are not named individually here.

points.name: Monument tegen apartheid en racisme
points.e: Monument tegen apartheid en racisme is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The statue from 1987 is by artist Pépé Grégoire. The bronze statue depicts human unity in diversity through an arm and a leg.

points.name: Monument to Keesje Bride
points.e: The Monument voor Keesje Brijde (also referred to as Keesje) is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Monument to the unsung
points.e: Monument to the unsung is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. It comes from the Iraqi-Kurdish artist Walid Siti, born in Duhok, and was placed as part of Framer Framed. Siti wants to call attention to women. In his view, too much attention goes to men in proportion.

points.name: Monument van Joodse Erkentelijkheid
points.e: The Monument van Joodse Erkentelijkheid, also known as the Monument van Joodse Dankbaarheid and the Wertheimmonument, is a monument on the Weesperplein in Amsterdam. It was erected in 1950 as an expression of thanks to the Amsterdammers who helped the Jewish population during the Second World War.

points.name: Monument voor Annick van Hardeveld
points.e: The Monument voor Annick van Hardeveld is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The monument, a hardstone plinth with a plaque, has been placed on the Hekelveld in front of the building with house number 25 (the point between the Spuistraat and the Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal). It was designed by artist Hans Bayens.

points.name: Monument voor de Canadese militairen
points.e: Amsterdam dankt zijn Canadezen is a monument in the Canadezenplantsoen, called the Apollolaan before 2020, in Amsterdam, opposite the Apollohal between the Stadionweg and the Bernard Zweerskade.

points.name: Monument voor de liefde
points.a: Sietse H. Bakker, Hanneke de Munck en Chatsjatoer Bjely.
points.e: Monument voor de liefde is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The monument was erected to celebrate the love between poet Osip Mandelstam and his wife Nadjezjda Mandelstam. He was a reviled poet in the Soviet Union under Jozef Stalin and his work was not published.

points.name: Monument voor de stad Amsterdam
points.e: The Monument voor de stad Amsterdam is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Artist Pieter Engels designed a statue of 18.000 kilograms of Swedish granite, concrete and steel for the place between the apartment blocks Groenhoven and Gouden Leeuw, at a cost of 150.000 guilders.

points.name: Monument voor de te jong gevallen boom
points.t: Monument voor de te jong gevallen boom
points.e: The Monument voor de te jong gevallen boom is an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The design of the statue comes from artist André van der Linden (Amsterdam, 1945), who studied for a year at the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten on the Stadhouderskade in Amsterdam, but is otherwise self-taught.

points.name: Monument voor een verdronken stad
points.e: Monument voor een verzonken stad is an artistic artwork standing in the Erasmuspark in Amsterdam-West. The work is dated 1981-1982 in the oeuvre of Berend Peter. At that time this transparent frame, essential according to the artist, was placed in the Frederik Hendrikplantsoen in Amsterdam.

points.name: Monument voor Joop den Uyl
points.e: The Monument voor Joop den Uyl is an artistic artwork in Zaanstad. It was designed by Jan Wolkers and unveiled in 1990.

points.name: Monument Walraven van Hall
points.e: The Monument Walraven van Hall is an artwork and war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The initiators of this sculpture were retired general practitioner Hans Weijers and retired medic Loek van Buchem, who set up a foundation to erect a monument to resistance fighter Walraven van Hall.

points.name: Monument Watersnoodramp 1960
points.e: The Monument Watersnoodramp 1960 is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord, Zonneplein. The statue is by Robbert Ritmeester and was placed in 1990. Ritmeester (1958) had only just graduated from the Gerrit Rietveld Academie at that time. It is a memorial to the flooding of the Tuindorp Oostzaan district on 14 January 1960.

points.name: Moodwall
points.e: Moodwall is an artistic viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. At the start of the 21st century, the Zuidoost borough saw much urban renewal. One of the reasons was the feeling of insecurity under the countless viaducts built in the borough in connection with the separated traffic flows.

points.name: Morgenster
points.e: Morgenster is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is by Arjen Lancel (1951). Lancel received a commission from Stadsdeel De Baarsjes for the Stadsreiniging Amsterdam, which had a branch (filiaal) with maintenance workshops on the Admiraal Helfrichstraat. The funding came from the Amsterdams Fonds van de Kunst.

points.name: Mother and child
points.e: Moeder en kind is an artwork in Amstelveen. It is a bronze statue from 1958 standing on a plinth, made by artist Nic Jonk. It stands in a bed of half-high shrubs on the Keizer Karelweg, where it crosses the Dr. Plesmansingel.

points.name: mural De Roggeveen
points.e: Muurschildering De Roggeveenstraat is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum, Zeeheldenbuurt. The painting was made by Klaartje Bruyn of Bont & Bruyn. De Roggeveen is a care centre of HVO Querido, an institution for social shelter and supported and sheltered living.

points.name: Mural Foodstrip
points.e: Mural Foodstrip is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The mural was applied by the street art artists "Karski & Beyond" and "Bier en Brood". The work symbolises the changes within the Amsterdam Zuidoost district and the Amstel III area. The artists felt that the diversity of the residents should be reflected in the artwork.

points.name: Mural Keith Haring
points.e: De Muurschildering van Keith Haring is an artwork by Keith Haring in Amsterdam-West. Haring applied the mural in 1986 to a depot of the Stedelijk Museum, located on the grounds of the Centrale Markthallen. He was staying in Amsterdam at that time for a solo exhibition in the aforementioned museum.

points.name: Mural Osdorpplein
points.e: De Muurschildering Osdorpplein is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The mural was placed in 1983 by Chilean artist Jorge Kata Nuñez. He was working at that time with the artists' collective Brigada Ramona Parra.

points.name: Mural Reigersbos
points.e: De Muurschildering Reigersbos is a mural in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. This mural was applied by the Utrecht illustrator and designer Munir de Vries in early summer 2019, and was unveiled on 29 June. De Vries, himself from the Reigersbos district, felt the grey walls did not suit the colourful (population makeup of the) district.

points.name: mural Thérèse Schwartze
points.e: De Muurschildering Thérèse Schwartze is a mural depicting artist Thérèse Schwartze on the building at Frans Halsstraat 35, which has a side wall on the Quellijnstraat.

points.name: Music and Joy
points.e: Muziek en vreugde is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Artist Bart van Hove originally made the statue to decorate the facade of the Amsterdam Stadsschouwburg on the Leidseplein.

points.name: Muur van Surinaamse en zwarte helden
points.t: Muur van Surinaamse en zwarte helden
points.e: De Muur van Surinaamse en zwarte helden is a mural several metres long in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Muurschildering Hemsterhuisbruggen
points.e: De Muurschildering Hemsterhuisbruggen is a multi-part mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

points.name: Muurschildering Kees de jongen
points.e: Muurschildering Kees de jongen is a mural on a partly blind facade of the building at Tuinstraat 61, Jordaan (Amsterdam-Centrum). The mural refers back to the novel Kees de jongen by Theo Thijssen.

points.name: Muurschildering Overschiestraatbrug
points.e: De Muurschildering Overschiestraatbrug is a mural on the abutments of the Overschiestraatbrug in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Muurschildering Rijswijkstraatbrug
points.e: De Muurschildering Rijswijkstraatbrug is a mural applied to an abutment of the Rijswijkstraatbrug in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The concrete of the southern abutment was given a tunnel painting in 2008. It is a creation by artist Frederik Molenschot.

points.name: Muurschildering Tweede Kostverlorenkade
points.e: De Muurschildering Tweede Kostverlorenkade is a mural in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: Muurschilderingen Nieuwe Hemweg
points.e: De Muurschilderingen Nieuwe Hemweg were two artistic artworks applied to blind walls along the Nieuwe Hemweg in Westpoort, Amsterdam.

points.name: Naaktfiguur
points.e: Naaktfiguur, also known as Meisje or Staand naakt, is the title of a statue in the Amsterdam Vondelpark. The statue dates from around 1957 and is by Frits Sieger. It was on show during the exhibition "Nederlandse Beeldhouwkunst '57" in the Museum Boijmans. The municipality of Amsterdam subsequently bought it in 1958.

points.name: Naald van Goedkoop
points.e: De Naald van Goedkoop (officially Zuil van Goedkoop) is a memorial and artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. During the war years a celebration nevertheless took place at the Nederlandsche Scheepsbouw Maatschappij. The celebration on 25 August 1944 marked the fiftieth anniversary of that company.

points.name: Nail House
points.e: Nail House (synonymous with holdout, standing one's ground) is an artwork that stood/stands temporarily in Amsterdam in 2015 and 2019. It is built after the model of a spijkerhuis or nagelhuis (nail house).

points.name: NAP-Stedenmaagd
points.e: NAP-Stedenmaagd is a mural as tall as a house in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: National Slavery Memorial
points.e: The Nationaal Monument Slavernijverleden is a monument in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam to commemorate the abolition of slavery in the Dutch Kingdom. The statue is made of bronze and the base is made of concrete.

points.name: Nautilus
points.e: Nautilus is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Barbara Nanning designed a ceiling relief for the gatehouse between the Erich Salomonstraat and the Theo Frenkelhof on IJburg. The commission came from the housing associations De Alliantie and Waterstad 3.

points.name: Nereus op zeepaard
points.e: Nereus op zeepaard is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. This creation of the god Nereus is by sculptor Nic Jonk (1928-1994). The statue stands in front of the boathouse and clubhouse of the rowing club ASR Nereus.

points.name: Newspapers and letters
points.e: Kranten en letters is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Although it is an artwork in public space, it can only be viewed by passengers on the Amsterdam Metro, specifically on the lines that use the so-called Oostlijntraject.

points.name: NO
points.e: NO (Paul Vendel) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The artwork was placed during the construction of the Waterwijk district, on the site of the relocated Gemeentewaterleidingen. During the layout (and its further existence) there was much deliberation to arrange the district according to residents' wishes.

points.name: No War
points.e: No war is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a so-called respect monument by artist Remco Swart. It was placed on the electricity cabin at the Balboaplein. It dates from 2005, with an unveiling on 22 June of that year by, among others, alderman (diversity, education and youth) Ahmed Aboutaleb.

points.name: Nooit Meer Teruggekomen
points.e: Nooit Meer Teruggekomen is a monument on the Prins Bernhardlaan in Amstelveen, dedicated to commemorating the Amstelveen victims of the persecution of Jews who were murdered during the Second World War. It was unveiled on 24 September 2020.

points.name: Noorderklankpark
points.e: Het Noorderklankpark is a collection of musical instruments in Amsterdam-Noord, Noorderpark. The instruments are made of corten steel. The designer of the large musical instruments is Hans van Dorp, an artist who works in sound and design.

points.name: Not in my back yard
points.e: Not in my back yard (Nimby) was an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a creation by Rob Voerman, made specifically for Amsterdam Zuidoost for a biennale held in 2009. It consists of a combination of steel, glass and polycarbonate.

points.name: Ode aan de paardenvijg
points.e: Ode aan de paardenvijg is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue by Aart Rietbroek was placed in 1972 in the small park of the Merwedeplein. Rietbroek reduced the form of a horse dropping to its essence: an abstracted heap of horse dung that has fallen apart into three pieces.

points.name: ODE's blozers
points.e: ODE's blozers is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Office goers
points.e: Kantoorgangers is a sculpture group on the Schalk Burgerstraat in Amsterdam-Oost. The statues were designed after the Woningbedrijf Amsterdam had renovated a housing complex by Jan Gratama on that street.

points.name: Olifant
points.e: Olifant is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work by Jan Meefout is at once a statue, a climbing object and a fountain. Meefout said in an interview in Het Parool of 1 November 1964: "I had to fill a large space, so you cannot come at it with a small creature".

points.name: Olifant India
points.e: Olifant India is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was one of the 105 elephants that took part in the Olifantenparade (Elephant Parade) in Amsterdam in 2009.

points.name: Olifant met kalf
points.e: Olifant en kalf is a composite form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Oost. The Transvaalplein was laid out and fully built up in the 1910s of the 20th century. The open space was regularly redesigned after that time.

points.name: Omgevallen boom
points.e: Omgevallen boom is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. In their second collaboration, Pieter Engels and Shlomo Korén created an artwork during a redevelopment of the Bickerseiland district in 1983. It resembles a sawn-out hollow tree. The residents saw nothing in it and invariably called it the Walvis (Whale).

points.name: Oneindigheid
points.e: Oneindigheid is an artistic artwork in the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery in Amsterdam-Oost. The cemetery was laid out around 1894 as the successor and replacement of the full Oosterbegraafplaats.

points.name: Ontmoeting
points.e: Ontmoeting is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Aart Lamberts made a number of identical statues around 1995. Ontmoeting was placed in the Middelveldsche Akerpolder district, on the island of the Heklaflat (address Matterhorn). Another work, Communicatie, stands in the Amsterdam Oosterpark.

points.name: Ontwakend Africa
points.e: Leda en de zwaan is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is Ben Guntenaar's depiction, from 1955, of the story of Leda and the swan. The story has inspired countless artists, particularly in paintings. Guntenaar carved it from natural stone. It first stood for years in the ponds in front of the GAK building on the Bos en Lommerplein in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: Oorlogsgedenkteken Tuindorp Oostzaan
points.e: Het Oorlogsgedenkteken Tuindorp Oostzaan is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The little-known statue was made by Jan Havermans, mainly known for his war memorial Monument gefusilleerde verzetsstrijders on the Apollolaan in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Oorlogsmonument Amstelveenseweg
points.e: Het Oorlogsmonument Amstelveenseweg is a memorial stone for four fallen members of the Binnenlandse Strijdkrachten (BS) in shootings on the Amstelveenseweg in Amsterdam-Zuid. The whole was designed by Ferdinand Jantzen. The statue was unveiled on 25 May 1946.

points.name: Oorlogsmonument Gerard Terborgstraat
points.e: Het Oorlogsmonument Gerard Terborgstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. The monument from 2017 was designed by Victor Levie.

points.name: Oorlogsmonument Harmoniehof
points.e: Het Oorlogsmonument aan het Harmoniehof is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a so-called Vrijheidsboom (Crimean linden, Tilia euchlora), planted in 1947 at the edge of one of the small parks that the Harmoniehof is rich in. The freedom tree, also known as the peace tree, is protected by an ornamental border of hardstone segments.

points.name: Oorlogsmonument Kinderdijkstraat
points.e: Het Oorlogsmonument aan de Kinderdijkstraat is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. The monument has two parts. Part 1 is a plaque, attached to the western facade of the studio homes on the Zomerdijkstraat.

points.name: Oorlogsmonument Witte de Withstraat
points.e: Het Oorlogsmonument aan de Witte de Withstraat is a memorial on the Witte de Withstraat in Amsterdam-West. The Witte de Withstraat is a street from around 1911 that runs from south to north. In its southern part, at house numbers 78-80, a stone has been placed in the facade to commemorate three war victims.

points.name: Open zuil, Frans Mossou 1988
points.e: Untitled (Frans Mossou) stands on the south-western bank of the Sloterplas. It has stood there since 2003 and dates from 1988. It is a 5 metre high column by artist Frans Mossou, made of corten steel. The column is supported by a concrete slab with a screen of the same material on top.

points.name: Oprichtersbank
points.e: De Jubileumbank Vondelpark of Oprichtersbank is a memorial bench in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Origin
points.e: Origin is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It was designed by Vendel & de Wolf.

points.name: Orso
points.e: Orso is a statue in Amsterdam-West. The artwork from 1997/1998 stands on the northern edge of the Erasmuspark, near the Wil de Graaffbrug over the Erasmusgracht, which dates from the same period. The standing polar bear (Orso is Italian for bear) looks out over the Erasmuspark and faces away from the former Augustanakerk.

points.name: Oscar Carré
points.e: Oscar Carré is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artist Fabrice Hünd ran a studio for years in the Amsterdam district De Pijp. He was asked to celebrate the 25th jubilee of the primary school Oscar Carréschool on the Eerste Jan van der Heijdenstraat by embellishing the site fence with an artwork.

points.name: Oude en jonge arbeider
points.e: De Oude en jonge arbeider is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. In 1956 the Nederlands Verbond van Vakverenigingen (NVV) celebrated its fiftieth anniversary. It then commissioned sculptor Han Wezelaar to make a statue for that anniversary.

points.name: Our land
points.e: Our land is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. Artist Judith de Leeuw placed a mural of Amy Winehouse in 2015/2016 on a blind wall of the corner building at Vijzelgracht (house number 47) and Fokke Simonszstraat.

points.name: Ouroboros Arborum
points.e: Ouroboros Arborum is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a work from 2007 by Sjoerd Buisman. The statue belongs to the art collection of that bank and stands near the Acanthusgebouw of ING Groep.

points.name: Oute Waal
points.e: Oute Waal dan wel Mollenmuur (1996) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work was initiated by Stadsdeel Oost (which had its offices here) and the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst. It consists of a number of panels (tableaux) designed by artist Ingrid Pasmans (Amby, 1964).

points.name: P.C. Hooft
points.e: The Borstbeeld P.C. Hooft is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bust was made at the request of the municipality of Amsterdam by sculptor Frits Sieger. Amsterdam marked the 300th anniversary of the death of Pieter Corneliszoon Hooft with a grand commemoration and all kinds of cultural activities.

points.name: P.W. Janssen
points.e: The Monument Peter Wilhelm Janssen is a memorial on the Bellamyplein in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: Paard
points.e: Paard is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

points.name: Paard en tafel
points.e: Paard en tafel is a two-part artistic artwork in the Waterwijk in Amsterdam-West. The artist Mathieu Nab made a set of three works around 1996, during the development of that district. A horse, a foal and a table were placed in a small park along the Waterrijkweg and Waterloop, footpaths and cycle paths that cut through the neighbourhood.

points.name: Paleisbeeld
points.e: Paleisbeeld, also known as Sarphati's visioen, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. In the years after founding it was given the nickname Eendenhotel (Duck Hotel). In Sarphatipark a bare platform stands in the pond in front of the Liefdesbruggetje. In 2020 the idea arose to fill that platform, until then used by ducks and other birds, with a statue.

points.name: Palen-staketsel (1987/2002)
points.e: Palen-staketsel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It dates from 1987 or 2002, when the artist Ger Dekker (1943-2020) taught at the Rietveld Academie in Amsterdam. By then Dekker had long stopped working figuratively and came up with this place: a hardstone plinth from which six wooden and nine steel poles point to the sky.

points.name: Pancakes aan 't IJ
points.e: Pancakes aan 't IJ was an artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist Hugo Kaagman had designed several artworks for the company Pancakes Amsterdam. He also took care of the interior fit-out for a number of branches. He gave them his personal style, with an emphasis on attributes resembling Delft blue.

points.name: Paradiso meteoriet
points.e: Paradiso meteoriet is an artistic artwork from 2026 that stands on a fenced, vacant building site south of Paradiso, Weteringschans, Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Passages
points.e: Passages is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It consists of an installation in the form of a colonnade, to a design by Arno van der Mark, placed in a gateway in the Woongebouw Piraeus. The artist worked on the work together with architect Hans Kollhoff of Piraeus.

points.name: Passer
points.e: Passer is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue depicts a pair of compasses, with which the circle on a small square in the Lizzy Ansinghstraat in De Pijp is said to have been drawn.

points.name: PAWS
points.e: PAWS is an artwork by Aisha Madu in Uilenstede, Amstelveen. The artwork consists of two sculptural cat paws, placed in front of the hospitality venue Upper East. The artwork is based on the stories of more than 75 residents and entrepreneurs about the student campus.

points.name: Pendulum
points.e: Pendulum is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue appeared under the percentage scheme of the Rijksgebouwendienst for the construction of the Vivaldigebouw, the new address of the European Medicines Agency at Domenico Scarlattilaan 6. A competition was held, which Gijs Assmann won.

points.name: Peperbus
points.e: Abri en peperbus is an artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is placed on the Van Limburg Stirumplein in the Staatsliedenbuurt. The work by Frank Halmans consists of two parts, a tram shelter and a pepperpot.

points.name: Peter Alma in Station Amsterdam Amstel
points.t: Peter Alma in Station Amsterdam Amstel
points.e: Three artworks by Peter Alma can be seen in the station hall of Station Amsterdam Amstel.

points.name: Phoenix
points.e: Phoenix, the Monument for the Fallen in Amsterdam-Noord, is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The artwork refers to the victims who fell during the bombings of Amsterdam-Noord in 1943 during the Second World War. As early as 1945 there were plans for such a monument. However, it remained quiet for a long time.

points.name: Phoenix
points.e: Phoenix is a form of public art in Amsterdam-Noord. Work on Het Breed, later called Plan van Gool after Frans van Gool, took place here between 1966 and 1970. That neighbourhood came to lie within a ring ditch around the Buikslotermeer.

points.name: Pinguïns
points.e: Penguins in an artwork by Jan Trapman in Amsterdam-Zuid. Trapman was one of the artists who, in the crisis years around 1930, received commissions from the municipality of Amsterdam to supply statues for a fee, so that they could continue to provide for their livelihood.

points.name: Piramide
points.e: Piramide is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a creation by Cornelius Rogge. In the 1960s it became somewhat known for a series of tents he had made. The drawback of the series was that these artworks gradually wore out and blew away.

points.name: Pirateneiland
points.e: Pirateneiland is a mural from 2026 in Amsterdam-Oost. The Oostelijk Havengebied was converted at the end of the 20th century from a harbour area into a residential area. One of the expressions of this is the Watertoren Entrepot-West, a skyscraper in Dutch style on the C. van Eesterenlaan.

points.name: Plaquette februaristaking
points.e: Plaquette Februaristaking is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bronze plaque was installed in 1976 on the south facade of the Noorderkerk in Amsterdam. The maker/designer is Ezechiël Jacob Hoek. It refers to a public gathering here of the Communist Party on 24 February 1941.

points.name: Plaquette Samuel Coster
points.e: The Plaquette Samuel Coster is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It actually consists of two plaques. The upper one shows a portrait of Samuel Coster, a physician by training, but also known as the founder of the first Amsterdamse Schouwburg in 1617.

points.name: plaquettes aan de Laing’s Nekstraat
points.e: Oorlogsmonument Laing's Nekstraat is a memorial on a school grounds on the Laing's Nekstraat in Amsterdam-Oost. The school grounds lie within a residential block on the streets Laing's Nekstraat, Transvaalstraat, Smitstraat and Pretoriusstraat.

points.name: Plastiek in landschap
points.e: Plastiek in landschap (Spiegelbeeld) is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The sculpture consists of two parts, both designed by artist Hans Mantje. The whole is made of stainless steel and stands in Park de Kuil near the Cort van der Lindenkade.

points.name: Plastische Tekens in Steen
points.e: Plastische tekens in steen is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artwork was designed by Ben Guntenaar and consists of twenty-one arranged and worked stones, which mostly stand in groups of three. Because of the combination of lying and standing stones, it popularly acquired the name Stonehenge, but on a small scale.

points.name: Played Rack
points.e: Played rack is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam. The creative artist Maze de Boer was inspired for this work by the climbing frames Iglo and Klimboog by Aldo van Eyck (English for climbing frame is Play rack) and by the drip racks that Jan van der Togt designed for Tomado (English for drip rack is Plate rack).

points.name: Players and supporters
points.e: Players and supporters is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. It is a group of four statues by artist Harmut Wilkening, placed after a redesign of this area where (many of) the Amsterdam ferries arrive and depart. The request came from the district council of Amsterdam-Noord, supported by the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst.

points.name: Pluk de Dag
points.e: Pluk de dag is a relatively inconspicuous and little-known artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a statue or group of statues in an open space at the northern end of the Vier Heemskinderenstraat and Twee Koningskinderenstraat, near the Bos en Lommerweg. Between the two streets lies a playground combined with a meeting space with concrete benches.

points.name: Poëziecartouches
points.e: The Poëziecartouches are two artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Pontus (Tom Claassen)
points.e: Pontus is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. Artist Tom Claassen made a concrete statue of a dog for the IJpromenade behind Station Amsterdam Centraal. The almost man-high dog stood, including its dog kennel, near the place where the IJ ferries arrive and depart.

points.name: Poolkleed
points.e: Poolkleed is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is applied art from 2005/2006 by Alphons ter Avest and stands in an unnamed open space on the Barentszstraat. The little square does, however, have a street name sign reading Pleintje zonder naam (square without a name).

points.name: Poort
points.e: The Blauwe poort is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. After a thorough clean-up in the neighbourhood around the Van Beuningenstraat in the Staatsliedenbuurt, part of the streets was made car-free.

points.name: Poort van Nieuwendam
points.e: Poort van Nieuwendam (De Poort) is an artistic and architectural artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Artist Marcel Smink (1967) won the commission around 1999 to design an artwork highlighting the junction of the IJdoornlaan and Zuiderzeeweg, which received a new traffic layout.

points.name: Portrettenhuisje
points.e: The Portrettenhuisje is an artistic work in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

points.name: Pride
points.e: Pride is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord.

points.name: primum movens ultimum moriens
points.e: The Gedenkteken Prof. Dr. Dirk Durrer is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. After the death on 3 March 1984 of cardiologist and professor of cardiology at the University of Amsterdam Dirk Durrer, a foundation was set up that worked to place a memorial somewhere in Amsterdam.

points.name: Prins Hendrik
points.e: The Borstbeeld Prins Hendrik de Zeevaarder is an artwork on the Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bust was made by Frans Stracké.

points.name: Prometheus
points.e: Prometheus is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a war memorial in memory of "sportspeople who perished" during the Second World War. The artist Fred Carasso depicted the Greek mythological figure Prometheus with a torch. According to the myth, Prometheus stole the fire of the Olympian gods to give it to humans.

points.name: Q42261376
points.e: The Kubuspoort is an artwork in the De Aker neighbourhood in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The "statue" stands at the edge of the Ecuplein, where bridge 1884 leads to the Pesetalaan. Marijke de Goey designed a gate several metres high, made of carelessly stacked and somewhat battered cubes, of which only the edges are made.

points.name: Raammannetjes
points.e: Raammannetjes consists of two artistic artworks in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. In the first years of the 21st century a renewal took place on the northern facade wall of the Postjesweg, between the Derkinderenstraat and Jan Tooropstraat.

points.name: Ramses Shaffy (mural)
points.e: The Muurschildering Ramses Shaffy, or Leef!, is a relatively small mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. Ramses Shaffy died in 2009, having lived for years in the Dr. Sarphatihuis on the Roetersstraat.

points.name: Raw Paradise
points.e: Raw paradise is a form of public art in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a light installation designed by Nicky Zwaan and installed on the Kruislaanspoorbrug. In 2008 a design competition for artists was announced, which drew 350 entries.

points.name: Rebirth magick
points.e: Rebirth magick is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. Artist Camile Smeets (1983; studied at the Gerrit Rietveld Academie) is credited with the concrete statue, which was made for the exhibition Concepts of mind on the occasion of 200 years of the Rijksmuseum van Oudheden in 2018.

points.name: Reinaert de vos
points.e: Reinaert de vos is a mural in Amsterdam-West. When the gallery-access housing was built in the Bos en Lommerbuurt, blind walls were chosen to close off the residential blocks. These grey blind facades were seen, especially in the first years of the 21st century, as signs of gloom and decay.

points.name: Rembo
points.e: Rembo is a statue in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The artist of the work is Bastienne Kramer. She was commissioned by the Slotervaart district, which required that the statue be extremely vandal-proof. Vandalism is quite frequent in and around the Rembrandtpark, where the statue stands.

points.name: Replacement Piece
points.e: Replacement piece is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a work by Ger van Elk, who replaced a piece at four road surfaces in Europe with a "monochrome colour print on a sheet of stainless steel".

points.name: Revisiting the Cullinan
