points.e: Bruidsjurk is an artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is by the artists' collective Patchwork, consisting of Elleke Haspels, Karolien Helweg and Joanneke Meester. The artists, working from the grounds of the Westergasfabriek, wanted to exhibit a large artwork of their own within the Netherlands.

points.name: City cells
points.e: City cells is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The work hangs from pillars along the connecting route over the Hoekenrode between Amsterdamse Poort, Station Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA and the Johan Cruijff Boulevard (until 2020 the ArenA Boulevard).

points.name: Commemorative plaque Westzaanstraat
points.e: The Plaquette Westzaanstraat is a war memorial (plaque) in Amsterdam-West. The plaque is found at house number 71 of the Westzaanstraat in the Spaarndammerbuurt. It refers to 22 March 1944, when an American Boeing B-17-G bomber crashed onto the Sint Alfonsusschool, which stood here at house numbers 61-63.

points.name: Communicatie
points.e: Communicatie is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work by Aart Lamberts was made in 1995 for placement in the Beeldenpark Drechtoevers beside the small river Noord near Papendrecht. The work consists of a base of a Stelcon slab, a bluestone plinth and a bronze statue.

points.name: Communicatieapparatuur
points.e: Communicatieapparatuur of Schakelbord is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a creation by Jos Wong. He was asked by the Dienst der Publieke Werken to supply a sculpture for a building at Lodewijk van Deysselstraat 16 / Van Moerkerkenstraat 17-19, which housed a police station and a telephone exchange.

points.name: Dak van de parkeergarage van Stibbe
points.t: Dak van de parkeergarage van Stibbe
points.e: The Dak van de parkeergarage van Stibbe is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is an example of applied art. The law firm Stibbe moved in the mid-2010s from the building De Tweeling (also known as StibbeTorens) to new construction at the Beethovenplein.

points.name: Dans van de vrede en welvaart
points.t: Dans van de vrede en welvaart
points.e: Dans van de vrede en welvaart is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Alternative titles are Boom der kennis and Jongen, meisje, vogels. It is a facade relief by Frits Sieger, placed on a school building in Slotermeer on the Burgemeester Fockstraat.

points.name: De Bal
points.e: De Bal is an artistic artwork in Amstelveen by artist Cindy Bakker. In 2019 the Amstelveen city council decided to make money available for 2020, 2021 and 2022 for the production of several 'child-friendly' artworks. With this, the council hoped to bring children at a younger age into contact with visual art.

points.name: De barmhartige Samaritaan
points.e: De barmhartige Samaritaan in Amstelveen is a monument in memory of help given after the Second World War.

points.name: De blauwe vogel van het geluk
points.t: De blauwe vogel van het geluk
points.e: De blauwe vogel van het geluk is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Artist Jan Kuipers was inspired for this statue by the story and play De blauwe vogel (French: L'Oiseau bleu) by Maurice Maeterlinck. In it, sister Mytyl and brother Tyltyl try to catch a blue bird so that they can heal their sick neighbour girl with it.

points.name: De denker
points.e: De denker is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a creation by Paul Koning, placed on a brick plinth near the entrance of the Gerrit van der Veen College on the Gerrit van der Veenstraat. It depicts a kneeling young man who, with his right arm, rests via the elbow on his right upper thigh.

points.name: De gek
points.e: De gek is an artistic artwork in Amstelveen. The statue is a creation by Lotti van der Gaag, who around 1950 made two versions: a small and a large one. The small one is privately owned, as is the large one. However, the large one was loaned in 2003 by Isis van Bohemen to the Cobra Museum voor Moderne Kunst.

points.name: De jonge Rembrandt
points.e: (De) Jonge Rembrandt is a statue by Wim van Hoorn that can be found in four places around the world. The original was made in 1968 for the 300th anniversary of the death of Rembrandt van Rijn. It was never completed, but the mould (and perhaps the statue too) ended up at Schiphol.

points.name: De lange glijbaan
points.e: De lange glijbaan, also known as De grote glijbaan, was an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

points.name: De spreekbuis
points.e: De spreekbuis was a form of art in public space in Amsterdam-Centrum, Wittenburg, on view between June and September 2024. It is part of the private project Welcome stranger by Marianna van der Zwaag, curator of the Oude Kerk, and Hester Elzenman, art historian.

points.name: De Wildplasser
points.e: De wildplasser is a statue in Amsterdam-Zuid at the IJsbaanpad. The Amsterdam football club ASV Arsenal was allowed to take a new sports ground into use here, connected to the Olympic Stadium. Under the heading 'Terreinwinst' (land gain), it then asked a team of eleven artists to develop art for the club and the neighbourhood.

points.name: De Wokkel
points.e: De wokkel is an artistic artwork on a civil engineering structure. It stands on the territory of the municipality of Amsterdam but is not part of that municipality. The statue stands on the national road 10 (ring road, A10), whose territory is managed by Rijkswaterstaat.

points.name: De Zonnewijzer
points.e: The Oorlogsmonument Van Houten is an expression of art in public space in the Dutch city of Weesp.

points.name: Dit is de koudste zomer van de rest van je leven
points.t: Dit is de koudste zomer van de rest van je leven
points.e: Dit is de koudste zomer van de rest van je leven is a temporary artistic artwork by visual artist and illustrator Hedy Tjin, applied to a steel plate on a retaining wall of the Haringpakkersbrug in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is the second expression of the Canvas van Amsterdam project and was produced by Mokumse Muurtjes.

points.name: Dolle Mina
points.e: Dolle Mina is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The work is by Erwin de Vries, who first designed it (in 1968) for the shopping centre De Botter in Lelystad. In 1999 that centre was thoroughly rebuilt, after which this work became available. The municipality of Amsterdam bought it.

points.name: Drie pergola's
points.e: Drie pergola's is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The three sculptures were placed in January 2011 on commission from the then Stadsdeel West. At that time the Laan van Spartaan neighbourhood was being completed, with the massive block of flats De Tribune as its largest eye-catcher, which was put into use in March 2011.

points.name: Duizend zonnen
points.e: Duizend zonnen is a mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. The artist Roland Schimmel has been known since the early 21st century for small and large paintings, which mainly consist of a misty white field in which he draws circles in the colours of the rainbow, standing out sharply against the background.

points.name: Eenheid in diversiteit
points.e: Eenheid in diversiteit is a mural ten by twelve metres in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is placed on the corner of the Lauernessestraat and the Wiltzanghlaan.

points.name: Empower yourself
points.e: Empower yourself ('Versterk jezelf') is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. For years there has been an electricity substation of Liander on the Hoofddorpplein. The little house was frequently a victim of graffiti. In 2011 Liander, or one of its predecessors, had it fitted with the artwork Hoofdzaak liefde by Fabrice Hünd.

points.name: Entree WG-Plein 100-873
points.e: The sculpture group Entree WG-Plein 100-873 is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. The group, made up of four (actually six) granite statues by Hildo Krop, adorns both entrances of the former surgical clinics of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis.

points.name: Fibonacci-reeks
points.e: Fibonaccireeks (1997) is the title of a neon sculpture by the Italian artist Mario Merz on the side facade of the Schiphol building, directly next to the A4 exit at Schiphol Airport. The very large artwork, within a square of 17.5 metres, may be classified as a 'lichtinstallatie' (light installation).

points.name: Four Peas in a Pod
points.e: Four peas in a pod is a mural at the corner of the Majoor Fransweg and the Wiltzanghlaan in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It measures ten by twelve metres.

points.name: Gaper Oh Johnny
points.e: Gaper Oh Johnny (2021) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum made by Amsterdam sculptor Adriaan Rees. It takes the form of a gaper.

points.name: Gedenkramen ter gelegenheid van het veertigjarig regeringsjubileum van koningin Wilhelmina
points.t: Gedenkramen ter gelegenheid van het veertigjarig regeringsjubileum van koningin Wilhelmina
points.e: The memorial windows on the occasion of the fortieth reign jubilee of Queen Wilhelmina are a memorial in the Nieuwe Kerk in Amsterdam.

points.name: Gedenkramen van de Bataafsche Petroleum Maatschappij in Amsterdam
points.t: Gedenkramen van de Bataafsche Petroleum Maatschappij in Amsterdam
points.e: The memorial windows of the Bataafsche Petroleum Maatschappij are three stained-glass windows in the Dutch city of Amsterdam, one of which can be regarded as a war memorial. The windows were installed in the stairwell on the west side of the Groot Laboratorium, built in 1929.

points.name: Gedenksteen restauratieatelier Uilenburg
points.e: The Gedenksteen restauratieatelier Uilenburg is a small memorial stone placed in the Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat in Amsterdam-Centrum. The grounds of the Uilenburger Synagogue are separated from the other buildings on the Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat by a wall. Two facade stones can be found in that brick wall.

points.name: Gedenksteen Vlooienburg
points.e: The Gedenksteen Vlooienburg is a war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. Its subtitle is: In memory of the last residents of Vlooienburg 1940-1945. The memorial stone was 'unveiled' on 15 November 2022. There could be no real unveiling; the monument takes the form of a stainless steel pavement tile.

points.name: Gedenkteken Adama van Scheltema
points.e: The Gedenkteken Adama van Scheltema is a statue in Amsterdam-Zuid. A year after the death of Carel Steven Adama van Scheltema (1877-1924), a committee was set up to create a memorial to this poet. Architect Jan Gratama and sculptor Tjipke Visser (a friend of the poet) were asked to make a design.

points.name: Gedenkteken P.L. Tak
points.e: Gedenkteken P.L. Tak is a memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a relief executed in brick in memory of Pieter Lodewijk Tak (1848-1907), journalist, politician and founder of the housing association De Dageraad.

points.name: Geloof, hoop en liefde
points.e: Geloof, hoop en liefde is a sculpture group in Amsterdam, made by the Australian artist Nicholas Pope. The three-part work, also referred to as Faith, hope and love, dates from 1997. Pope made them for placement on the facade of one of the buildings of the Koninklijk Instituut voor de Tropen.

points.name: Gevelsteen Sint Victor
points.e: The Gevelsteen Sint Victor is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a depiction of Victor of Marseille, patron saint of corn millers. The facade stone was placed on 17 October 2017 in the facade of the fire station on the corner of the Marnixstraat and the Rozengracht.

points.name: Glimlach
points.e: Glimlach is a two-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam. It is located in the two 'branches' of the OLVG. In 2015 the Onze Lieve Vrouwe Gasthuis in Amsterdam-Oost merged with the Sint Lucas Andreas Ziekenhuis in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: Gordel van smaragd
points.e: Gordel van smaragd is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artwork hangs on the facade of Sumatrastraat 146-160 in the Indische Buurt, which is named after the Dutch East Indies and which Multatuli also called the Gordel van smaragd (Emerald Girdle). This neighbourhood underwent a large-scale renovation around 1980 and again around 1997.

points.name: Grafmonument van Cornelis van Doorn
points.e: The Grafmonument van Cornelis van Doorn is a monument honouring civil engineer Cornelis van Doorn in Amsterdam-Oost. This engineer, mainly known in Japan, was buried at De Nieuwe Ooster in 1906, then still the Nieuwe Oosterbegraafplaats. Over the years his grave fell into disrepair, and there were plans to clear it.

points.name: Grafmonument van Ookawa Kitaroo
points.e: The Grafmonument van Ookawa Kitaroo is a monument honouring the Japanese man Kitarō Ōkawa.

points.name: Griekse vrouwen met kruik
points.e: Griekse vrouwen met kruik is an unofficial name for two statues standing in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Vondelpark. On 4 May 1881 the renewed Vondelpark pavilion was opened. This came in place of a wooden pavilion.

points.name: Groei
points.e: Groei is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. It is a mural by Munir de Vries from May 2020 that adorns the front and side facade of the building at Bijlmerplein 876 in the Amsterdamse Poort shopping centre (neighbourhood). The mural was made in advance of a large overhaul of the neighbourhood.

points.name: Heilig Hartbeeld
points.e: The Heilig Hartbeeld is a statue in the Dutch town of Diemen.

points.name: Hendrik Petrus Berlage
points.e: Hendrik Petrus Berlage is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. In the 1920s the Kroonenberg Groep redeveloped the building at Apollolaan 171 in Amsterdam. A building by Wim Quist was demolished down to the cellar. A new building was subsequently erected to a design by the Office for Metropolitan Architecture (OMA).

points.name: Here comes the sun
points.e: Here comes the sun is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work from 2018 by Chris Kabel (Bloemendaal, 1975) consists of 4500 transparent glass lenses and filters that appear to be stuck to the facades of the new building of the Metis Montessori Lyceum at Mauritskade 58.

points.name: Het duikstertje
points.e: Het duikstertje is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is a small statue from 2018 made by Street Art Frankey. This artist makes all kinds of small art expressions for the city of Amsterdam, which in his view are meant to brighten up the dull street scene.

points.name: Het lint
points.e: Het lint is an artistic artwork in Amstelveen. It is a cross between a social sofa and a decorated bridge railing. When the Stadshart Amstelveen was redesigned in 2006, the Project Buurtmozaïeken Amstelveen was started. Part of the project is involving neighbourhood residents in the design of the districts.

points.name: Het verlangen
points.e: Het verlangen is a sculpture group in Duivendrecht, in the municipality of Ouder-Amstel. It is the creation of the artist duo Berkman and Janssens, Margot Berkman and Eline Janssens, and from 2008 it stood on either side of the part of the Holterbergweg that lies in the municipality of Ouder-Amstel.

points.name: Houten Driehoeken
points.e: Houten driehoeken is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a creation by artist Josum Walstra, consisting of five interlocking triangles of untreated wood. The triangles stand in the Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark, near the access via bridge 835 to and from the Van Nijenrodeweg.

points.name: I want to ride my bike
points.t: I want to ride my bike
points.e: I want to ride my bike is a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. This small mural was made by the Italian Yuri Romagnoli and signed at the top left with Hopnn. Hopnn is a street art artist. With I want to ride my bike, Hopnn tried, within climate activism, to encourage people to take the bicycle instead of the car.

points.name: Ik heb ze lief
points.e: Ik heb ze lief is an artistic artwork and mural in Amsterdam-Centrum. During the large-scale clearance of the Czaar Peterstraat at the start of the 21st century, a number of buildings were demolished. For the building with house number 135 this meant that its blind side facade came to stand on the Tweede Leeghwaterstraat.

points.name: In tune
points.e: In tune is a temporary artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. It was unveiled (or rather launched on the water) on 1 October 2022, operational from 2 October, and the plan is for it to remain until December 2023.

points.name: Kastanje
points.e: Kastanje is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It is formed by a 'peeled' chestnut nut surrounded by four quarters of the cup. Three parts of the shell lie with the inside facing up and a fourth lies on its side. The whole, in bronze, was designed by Handle with Care, a landscape architecture firm.

points.name: Keienmonument
points.e: The Keienmonument is a memorial and artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. It is located on the embankment of the Oostzanerdijk (at the Kometensingel), a dike in Amsterdam-Noord that partly forms the dividing line between Tuindorp Oostzaan and Molenwijk.

points.name: Kijker
points.e: Kijker is an art object designed by Barbara Kletter. The artwork, including a small bridge that forms part of it, is located in the mill ditch that runs parallel to the Hugo de Vrieslaan in Amsterdam, named after biologist Hugo de Vries. Kletter was asked to design an art object with a connection to science.

points.name: Kinderkunst Linnaeusschool
points.e: Kinderkunst Linnaeusschool is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The design of the artwork comes from a learning programme of the then pupils of the Linnaeusschool on the Derde Oosterparkstraat in Amsterdam-Oost. They were guided by artist and art teacher Piet van de Kar.

points.name: Kissing monkeys
points.e: Kissing monkeys Covid-19 (Apen) is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a mural, a so-called graffiti painting, made in 2023 by RoosArt, that is Rosalie de Graaf.

points.name: Kroon- en ritterlantaarn
points.e: The kroonlantaarn and ritterlantaarn are two facade stones in Amsterdam-Centrum, on a transformer house at Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat 29a. Facade stones were placed in Amsterdam to indicate a location better than average in times when streets had no house numbers.

points.name: Lady Solid
points.e: Lady Solid, better known as Het waternetmeisje, is an artistic artwork and fountain in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue dates from around 1994. At that time residents around the Krugerplein in Amsterdam-Oost chose between two designs for a fountain. Peer Veneman came up with Fontein Krugerplein and Caro Bensca with Lady Solid.

points.name: Let me be myself
points.e: Let me be myself is a 240 sq m mural by the Brazilian neo-muralist Eduardo Kobra on the facade of the old welding shed at the NDSM-werf in Amsterdam-Noord. Kobra made the painting in 2016 on commission from the municipality of Amsterdam and the Amsterdam street art platform Street Art Today.

points.name: Limietpalen Oosterpark
points.e: De Limietpalen Oosterpark are two columns in Amsterdam-Oost. In the Oosterpark stand two almost identical boundary posts, which marked the border between two municipalities, or ban posts, which marked the limit 1.5 miles beyond the municipal boundary, up to which banished people were allowed to approach the city.

points.name: Liro-plaquette
points.e: The Liro-plaquette is a plaque placed on the building at Sarphatistraat 47-55 in Amsterdam-Centrum. From 1941 to 1945 the bank Lippmann, Rosenthal & Co. was based in this building, a robber bank. On 26 March 2003 the plaque was unveiled by Ronny Naftaniel.

points.name: Lobi, aşk, amor
points.e: Lobi, aşk, amor is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Looplijnen
points.e: Looplijnen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West, Spaarndammerbuurt. The artwork lies in the floor of the Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen. That floor carried the Maria Magdalenakerk from 1891 to 1967, whose remains are still visible here and there in the small park. When the square was spruced up, the floor was retiled.

points.name: Man en Schaap
points.e: Man en schaap is a statue in Amsterdam-Oost. It stands in a pond surrounded by the Flevoparkweg, the Zeeburgerdijk and the Zuiderzeeweg. The basis for the artwork was Merijn Bolinks idea of once designing a fountain. He wanted it to feature a statue of a man and a woman. For inspiration he went to a party shop.

points.name: Martin Luther King
points.e: The Beeld van Martin Luther King is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. In 2018 artist Airco Caravan (also known as Maria Koning or Ine Reijnen) wanted to draw attention to Martin Luther King's death date under the heading Monument for Martin Luther King, by having a half-metre statuette placed in cities in Europe and North America.

points.name: Memorial D.G. Pronk
points.e: The D.G. Pronk memorial consists of a plaque attached to the church in Holysloot, Amsterdam-Noord. Dedelef Gustaaf (Deef or Dave) Pronk (Holysloot, 22 August 1922 - Rotterdam, 12 March 1945) was a Dutch office clerk. He was the son of Hilletje Kruse and Jacob Pronk, both born within the municipality of Ransdorp, to which Holysloot belonged.

points.name: Mercurius
points.e: Mercurius or Hermes is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a relief placed on the building at Burgemeester Röellstraat 40 in Amsterdam, completed in 1956. The relief is, however, located on the facade on the Jacobus van Looystraat.

points.name: Middenstip Stadion De Meer
points.e: Middenstip is an artwork by Harald Vlugt, placed in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Watergraafsmeer. The artwork can be seen in Park de Meer, Esplanade de Meer. Buildings, streets and bridges here are named after things connected with football. The neighbourhood was built on the site where Stadion De Meer stood until 1996, for many years the home ground of AFC Ajax.

points.name: Mikado (beeld)
points.e: Mikado is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. In 1985 the multifunctional building De Open Vaart was completed on the northern edge of the Hagedoornplein, opposite what would later become Plein Spanje '36-'39. The building, designed by Pi de Bruijn, housed a school, an art lending library and a neighbourhood centre with all kinds of facilities.

points.name: Mimicry
points.e: Mimicry is a multi-part artistic artwork on the dividing line between Amsterdam Oud-West and Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Between 1966 and 1969 a large viaduct was built, which in that last year was meant to span the Erasmusgracht. The motorway on top of it was Rijksweg 10, Ringweg-West.

points.name: Mise-en-scène
points.e: Mise-en-scène is a two-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. In 2015 the work was placed at the entrances of Station Amsterdam RAI, commissioned by ProRail, by artists Anna de Jong and Anne Huijnen working under the name Polly's Picture Show.

points.name: monument op het Transvaalplein
points.e: The Monument Transvaalplein is a war memorial for the Holocaust victims from the Transvaal neighbourhood in Amsterdam. The relief hangs on the building at Transvaalplein 1 in Amsterdam-Oost, but cannot be seen there, because it hangs on a side wall along the Transvaalstraat.

points.name: Monument voor de Tachtigers
points.e: The Monument voor de Tachtigers is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artist Jan Wolkers was inspired for this statue by a poem that Hendrik Marsman wrote when Herman Gorter died in 1927: 'He was of fire, a wave, a flame, a flowing piece of nature.' The statue of stainless steel was placed in the Oosterpark in 1992.

points.name: Monument voor de vliegramp op 7 juni 1989
points.t: Monument voor de vliegramp op 7 juni 1989
points.e: Monument voor de vliegramp op 7 juni 1989 is a statue placed in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a statue by Amsterdam artist Guillaume Lo-A-Njoe, which commemorates the SLM disaster of 7 June 1989 at Zanderij airport in Suriname.

points.name: Monument voor Joes Kloppenburg
points.e: The Monument voor Joes Kloppenburg is an art installation in Amsterdam-Centrum. The commission for this work came from the Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst. The whole was designed by Paul Vendel and Sandra de Wolf (Vendel and de Wolf), both graduates of the Gerrit Rietveld Academie, in collaboration with poet Martin Reints.

points.name: Mural Hofgeest
points.e: The Mural Hofgeest is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artists' collective RUA (Reflexo on Urban Art) was commissioned to brighten up the monotonous high-rise flats in the H-buurt in the Amsterdam district after a renovation. Brazilian street artist Speto (Sao Paulo, 1971) was affiliated with that collective at the time.

points.name: Mural Hogevecht
points.e: The Mural Hogevecht is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artists' collective RUA (Reflexo on Urban Art) was commissioned to brighten up the monotonous high-rise flats in the H-buurt in the Amsterdam district after a renovation. For the Hogevecht Oost flat this became a full-height facade mural by Brazilian artist Rimon Guimarães.

points.name: Mural Oostenburg
points.e: Muurschildering Oostenburg is a mural painted on one of the former factory halls on the Oostenburgermiddenstraat in Amsterdam-Oostenburg. The request for this mural came from Stadgenoot, which was building in the neighbourhood.

points.name: mural Zeeburgerdijk
points.e: The Muurschildering Zeeburgerdijk is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Zeeburgerdijk 49 is part of a northern facade wall with house numbers 27 to 49 on the Zeeburgerdijk. The buildings date from around 1914. The built-up frontage ends here, because the Zeeburgerdijk railway bridge on the Amsterdam - Amersfoort line has been here since 1901.

points.name: Muur van de dichters
points.e: Muur van de dichters is an interactive artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a creation by artist Danilo Joanovic. It consists of a panel with two loudspeakers. From the loudspeakers the listener can hear several texts by writers and poets who gave their names to streets and squares in the area.

points.name: Muurschildering Emanuel van Meterenstraat
points.e: Muurschildering Emanuel van Meterenstraat is an artwork in the form of a mural in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The mural, dating from October 2016, is an initiative of a resident of the Emanuel van Meterenbuurt (named after the Emanuel van Meterenstraat, which was itself named after Emanuel van Meteren in 1955).

points.name: Muurschildering Heesterveld
points.e: The Muurschildering Heesterveld, nicknamed Vissenmuur, is a mural on an almost blind facade of the low-rise Heesterveld flats in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The mural dates from 2012, when the block had just been saved from demolition but still looked grey and drab.

points.name: Muurschildering Johan Cruijff
points.e: The Muurschildering Johan Cruijff is a mural in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer. The portrait of Johan Cruijff was applied in 2017 to the side wall of a residential block on the Anfieldroad, at right angles to the Wembleylaan. Those streets were laid out on the grounds of the former AFC Ajax stadium, Stadion De Meer.

points.name: Muurschildering The Student Hotel Amsterdam City
points.e: Muurschildering Student Hotel Amsterdam is a mural in Amsterdam-Oost. The Brazilian street artist Cranio (pseudonym of Fabio Oliviera) was in Amsterdam in 2016. His murals can be seen around the world, from London to São Paulo.

points.name: Nachtwacht
points.e: Nachtwacht is a statue designed by Lisa Couwenbergh. The statue symbolises the watchful eye that stood guard so that large parts of the residential blocks here would not be demolished at the end of the 20th century. The De Pijp neighbourhood had become run down, and the municipality wanted large-scale demolition and new construction.

points.name: Nescio
points.e: Nescio is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. It consists of a relief made in 2008 by Da van Daalen for Het Nesciohuis at Sarphatistraat 252-366 in Amsterdam. From 1870 the building housed the Rijks Militair Hospitaal, from 1929 the Nederlands Kanker Instituut and the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek Ziekenhuis.

points.name: Nijlpaard
points.e: Nijlpaard is an artistic artwork by sculptor Tom Claassen. The Nijlpaard, a hippopotamus 6 by 3 metres in size, is made of rubber and stands on the Paul Hufkade in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Nikè
points.e: Nikè is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. This depiction of Nikè is by sculptor Guido Sprenkels and stands on the Abcouderpad, where the path winds between the buildings of ROC Amsterdam in Zuidoost.

points.name: Now speak!
points.e: Now speak! is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The statue, in the form of a concrete lectern, is by artist Amalia Pica, who was born in Argentina but lives in London (and Amsterdam). It was an invitation to the local population to speak out about everything and nothing.

points.name: Ode aan verbinding
points.e: Ode aan verbinding is an unorthodox mural in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The artistic artwork is a neighbourhood initiative by residents of the Snelleveldstraat in the Reigersbos neighbourhood. In the eyes of artist Munir de Vries, this neighbourhood was marked by uniformity.

points.name: Omgekeerde spijkerbroek
points.e: Omgekeerde spijkerbroek is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The title was given by the local residents, based on its shape. The creative artist Helly Oestreicher (1936, a pupil of the Gerrit Rietveld Academie) was less poetic; she calls it Gevelbekroning. Buitenkunst Amsterdam got no further than blue glass objects on the roof.

points.name: Ontmoetingsplaats
points.e: Ontmoetingsplaats is an artwork by Shinkichi Tajiri in Amsterdam-Noord. It is a white concrete meeting place with some areas of red asphalt. The artist designed it as a real meeting place, but it is apparently too remote for that. It has the appearance of a series of low platforms and a staircase.

points.name: Pan and Syrinx
points.e: Pan en Syrinx is a facade sculpture by Willem IJzerdraat on the Jan Lievensstraat in the Diamantbuurt, Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Phoenix
points.e: Phoenix is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a mosaic set on the northern side wall of the Burgemeester Cramergracht 1-98 flats. The mosaic was designed by artist Raymond Both and placed on a block designed by architect Piet Zanstra.

points.name: Plaquette H.F. Westerveld
points.e: The Plaquette H.F. Westerveld is a plaque in memory of resistance work by Heijmen Friedrich Westerveld (Amsterdam, 20 August 1896 - Soest, 23 June 1980). The memorial plaque was unveiled on 7 May 1947 by Prince Bernhard, in the presence of minister L. Neher and General Jhr. W. Roëll, at the Koepelkerk on the Stadhouderskade in Amsterdam.

points.name: Plaquette Herman Elteschool
points.e: The Plaquette Herman Elteschool is a small war memorial in Amsterdam-Zuid. This plaque was unveiled on 13 March 2012. It was placed in memory of the Jewish teachers and pupils of the Herman Elteschool who were deported and killed during the Second World War.

points.name: Plateau met lijst
points.e: On Ben Websterstraat in Slotervaart, Amsterdam, stands an untitled abstract artwork. Colloquially it is also called Plateau met lijst. The artwork, designed by artist Irini Schrijer, consists of a stone plateau with a stainless steel frame attached to it. The stone plateau does not lie entirely horizontally in the street paving.

points.name: Podium voor tijdelijke kunst
points.e: The Podium voor tijdelijke kunst is an artistic artwork in Vondelpark, Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies near the Vondelstraat entrance, opposite number 164. The podium, in the form of a large disc of hard stone, was placed in 2011 to a design by landscape architects Quirijn Verhoog and Arno Heemskerk.

points.name: Polaris
points.e: Polaris is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Oud-West. Artist Wendela Gevers Deynoot made this work of stainless steel around 1987. Polaris refers to two different worlds that meet. On the south side of the statue is the densely populated Staatsliedenbuurt, with its narrow streets.

points.name: Potkachel
points.e: De potkachel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It stands in the central reservation at the end of the Jan van Galenstraat, where the slope begins at its junction with the A10, the ring road around Amsterdam.

points.name: Quint
points.e: Quint is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue, dating from 2006, is the work of Ewerdt Hilgemann. It was made on commission for the Hervormd Lyceum Zuid, and it stands in the back garden of that school. Quint represents the style and materials that Hilgemann has used since 1984.

points.name: Recycled '92
points.e: Recycled '92 is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. The creation by Menno Boddé (1959), artist and later teacher at the Adriaan Roland Holstschool in Bergen, stands on the Martin Vlaarkade in the Spaarndammerbuurt. The Martin Vlaarkade lies on the Van Noordtgracht, which bends there and becomes the Le Mairegracht.

points.name: Reliëf Franz Liszt
points.e: The Reliëf Franz Liszt is a relief in Amsterdam-Centrum. The relief by sculptor Gyöngyi Szathmáry was placed in April 1991 above the main entrance of the Mozes en Aäronkerk on the Waterlooplein.

points.name: Rode Pylonen
points.e: Rode pylonen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work, consisting of three pylons, was designed by Hendrik Jan van Herwijnen. They rose on the Iepenplein when that square was redeveloped in the period 1980-1989. On the north side of the square, where it is crossed by the Tweede Oosterparkstraat, two pylons stand right next to each other.

points.name: Rode Pylonen
points.e: Rode pylonen is an artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The work, consisting of three pylons, was designed by Hendrik Jan van Herwijnen. They rose on the Iepenplein when that square was redeveloped in the period 1980-1989. On the north side of the square, where it is crossed by the Tweede Oosterparkstraat, two pylons stand right next to each other.

points.name: Roosje
points.e: Roosje is a mural in Amsterdam Oud-West. It is by the Dutch artist Rombout Oomen. Oomen painted part of the text of the erotic poem Aan een roosje by Jacob van Lennep, which was published only after the poet's death.

points.name: Rotsfontein Oosterpark
points.e: The Rotsfontein Oosterpark is a fountain in the Oosterpark. The Oosterpark was laid out around 1891, with the large fountain at the centre of the pond. Later a small fountain was added in the children's paddling pool by Aldo van Eyck on the northern edge of the park.

points.name: Samen bij De Boeg
points.e: Samen bij De Boeg is a mural as tall as the building it covers, on the building at Hoofdweg 495 in Amsterdam-West.

points.name: Schaap
points.e: Schaap met vijf poten is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue, dating from 1969, is by Gerrit Bolhuis and stands near the Botteskerksingel in Osdorp. The bronze statue is constructed so that it can bear the body of a child. With this statue Bolhuis in particular invited children to use it as a play object.

points.name: Schakelobject 3
points.e: Schakelobject 3 is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue is a creation by De Boer Lichtveld (Frans de Boer, 1942-2016, and Marja de Boer Lichtveld, 1941) from 1977. It is built of stainless steel and perspex, the parts of which are bolted together. There are nine blocks in the form of rhombus-shaped cubes.

points.name: Scherven van beschaving
points.e: Scherven van beschaving is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The artwork marks a retaining wall of Station Amsterdam Muiderpoort on the Pontanusstraat. It is one of the mosaics by Fabrice Hünd, which he himself called a megamosaic, and which Amsterdam is rich in.

points.name: school nr. 2
points.e: An untitled diptych by artist Claire Begheyn hangs on the school building of De Witte Olifant at Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat 96, Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Screenview
points.e: Schermzicht (June 2009) is a photo project by visual artist Claire Felicie on noise barriers along the A10-west in Amsterdam. The project was realised in collaboration with Rijkswaterstaat.

points.name: Sluis
points.e: Sluis is a three-part artwork by Lon Pennock, standing in Amsterdam-Oost. The sculpture group stands where the Kruislaan bends into the Rozenburglaan and where a cycle path passes under the Gooiseweg. On the east side of the group is bridge 168, and on the west side the Kruislaanbrug (bridge 458), over which the Gooiseweg runs.

points.name: Speelobjecten Iepenplein
points.e: The Speelobjecten Iepenplein is an artwork and piece of applied art in Amsterdam-Oost. It consists of four stone sculptures lying on the Iepenplein. Artist Lobke Alkemade designed four objects of polished natural stone for the landscape architecture firm Handle with Care.

points.name: Speelslinger Oosterpark
points.e: The Speelslinger Oosterpark is an artistic and architectural artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. The play structure came about at the request of the Amsterdam municipality, which had a play apparatus designed for a new playground in the Oosterpark. The park was given a major makeover in the 2010s.

points.name: Spelende kinderen
points.e: Spelende kinderen, also known as Kinderfiguren or De engeltjes, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Artist Gerrit Bolhuis made a sculpture group for the De Nieuwe Ooster cemetery. The cemetery calls the group the Engelenbak. It basically consists of six sandstone pedestals.

points.name: Spiegelkubus
points.e: Spiegelkubus is an artwork by Yvonne Kracht. It was placed in front of the older building of Sanquin, dating from 1959, at Plesmanlaan 125 in Amsterdam, Slotervaart. The work dates from around 1984, a time when the artist worked with open spatial objects. In this case it is a cube.

points.name: Stamboom
points.e: Stamboom is a mural ten by twelve metres in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is located on the corner of the Lauernessestraat and the Wiltzanghlaan.

points.name: Steen van Rosetta
points.e: De Steen van Rosetta is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. This version of the Rosetta Stone is the work of artist Dirk Müller. It was placed in Park Frankendael in 1979. The work consists of a large boulder that is polished smooth on one side.

points.name: Stenen gedicht
points.e: Stenen gedicht is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. In 2001 the Batavia residential building was erected at Panamalaan 10-186 in Amsterdam-Oost, designed by architect Frits van Dongen. It is a U-shaped building that ends on the Panamalaan in a kind of pointed wedge with a sharp corner.

points.name: Straatpoëzie Tuindorp Oostzaan
points.e: Straatpoëzie Tuindorp Oostzaan is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. After a major renovation of homes in the Tuindorp Oostzaan neighbourhood by Ymere, the housing association asked poet Toon Tellegen for a number of texts that could be attached to various facades in the area.

points.name: Tension pieces
points.e: Tension pieces is a two-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. In 1977 artist Shlomo Koren designed a diptych for the two entrances of Metro station Holendrecht, which was rebuilt as Station Amsterdam Holendrecht in 2004-2008.

points.name: The Angel
points.e: De Engel is a sculpture by Han Richters placed on the building at Blankenstraat 2 in Amsterdam-Centrum. Richters designed the statue at the request of the Dutch Reformed Congregation, which opened a new neighbourhood building here in 1952. Richters took the inspiration for this seraph from Isaiah 6:2.

points.name: The more of you the more I love you
points.t: The more of you the more I love you
points.e: The more of you the more I love you is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a neon sculpture by artist Tracey Emin. With it Emin put her own statement, in her own handwriting, in flamingo-pink neon light on a facade.

points.name: Tijgervrouwen
points.e: Tijgervrouwen or Tijgermoeders is a mural ten by twelve metres in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is located on the corner of the Ferdinand Huyckstraat and the Wiltzanghlaan.

points.name: Timpaan
points.e: Timpaan is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Centrum. When the Oranje Nassaukazerne on the Sarphatistraat in Amsterdam was built, the tympanums were filled with sculpture made in the studio of city sculptor Christiaan Welmeer. The tympanum on the west side, on the later Kazernestraat, however remained empty.

points.name: Toegangshek Vondelpark
points.e: The Vondelpark gate on the Amstelveenseweg is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. Vondelpark has several entrances, which were added over the years. A number of them have been designated national monuments. First is the entrance on the Stadhouderskade, the main entrance.

points.name: Toegangspoort Aemstel Schooltuinen
points.e: The Toegangspoort Aemstel Schooltuinen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. In the Ecolint Amsterdam, a green strip between the Watergraafsmeer and the Amstelveenseweg, a new school garden complex (Aemstel schooltuinen) opened in 2014. It replaced the Dr. L. Alma school garden, which had to make way for new construction for the VUmc.

points.name: Toegangspoort Speeltuin De Waag
points.e: The Toegangspoort Speeltuin De Waag is a gate in Amsterdam-Centrum designed by artist Su Tomesen. Speeltuin De Waag is a playground for children on the Oudeschans in Amsterdam. It lies in the inner courtyard of an almost completely enclosed residential block, which has only two entrances to the quay along the Amsterdam canal.

points.name: Toekomst en Verleden
points.e: Toekomst en verleden is an artwork in Halfweg. It is a statue of French limestone designed by local artist Joep van Opzeeland. A woman with a suitcase depicts a traveller.

points.name: Trimmers
points.e: Trimmers is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The work by Martie van der Loo, which was originally meant to be on view only temporarily, is located on the outside of the railings of Bridge 678, which spans the President Allendelaan in the Sloterpark. A fitness trail runs over the bridge.

points.name: Under Heaven 02
points.e: Under Heaven 02, also known as Fata morgana, is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West on the dividing line with Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It is a panel by artist Leonard van Munster, a local resident. It is part of a series beginning with Under Heaven 01 from 2004, a treehouse, which was destroyed during the demolition of the Post CS building.

points.name: Under Heaven 03
points.e: Under Heaven 03 is an artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It consists of a children's playhouse on an 'unreachable island' in a pond, in water that runs under the start of the Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan north-south. The little house stands just south of the Frieda Belinfantebrug.

points.name: Unity in Diversity
points.e: The Gedenkteken Nelson Mandela is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Artist Steffen Maas made a mosaic portrait of Nelson Mandela for the corner building at Krugerplein and Pretoriusstraat (also called De Krugerkop). The mosaic is built up from hundreds of small wooden tiles with South African patterns.

points.name: Vaarwel
points.e: Vaarwel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West, in the Spaarndammerbuurt. The statue by Godelieve Smulders refers to two historical events. The first refers to the time when this neighbourhood had not yet been built at all. Around 1890 the Maria Magdalenakerk by Pierre Cuypers was under construction on the southern edge of the neighbourhood.

points.name: Vaste klant
points.e: Vaste klant is a bronze statue by Groningen artist Albert Zweep (born 1957). The statue is placed on the seating belonging to the café 'Festina Lente' at Looiersgracht 40B in Amsterdam. As a beginning artist, the artist was a regular there and drank on credit.

points.name: Verandering van richting
points.e: Verandering van richting was two artistic artworks in Amsterdam. Manson also created an artwork for the Bijlmerweide. According to the artist, it shares with Verandering van richting the common theme of Escape: not being afraid to take a different direction, and being open to new ideas.

points.name: Vergeet nooit te dromen
points.e: Vergeet nooit te dromen is a private but publicly visible artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Vijf stadia van een reis
points.e: Vijf stadia van een reis is a three-part relief in Amsterdam-Centrum.

points.name: Vijfstromenland
points.e: Vijfstromenland is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. It was made by Carel Visser. In 2020 the statue lies in the green strip between the Royal Tropical Institute and the Linnaeusstraat. When it was placed in 1981, it stood in a pit slightly further north.

points.name: Visvrouw
points.e: (De) Visvrouw is an artwork in Amsterdam-Noord. The statue of this fishwife stands on the Purmerweg in a small park at the crossing with the Schermerstraat. The artist Karin Beek paid tribute with the statue to the fishermen (often men) and fish traders (often women) in and from Nieuwendam. It goes back to the time when the village still lay by the sea.

points.name: Vleugelvormen (Felix van Kalmthout)
points.e: Vleugelvormen is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid, in the Beatrixpark. It is a statue by Felix van Kalmthout. The 'Vereniging Vrienden van het Beatrixpark' (Friends of the Beatrixpark association) was founded in 1981, and it immediately wanted an artwork placed in the park.

points.name: Vlinders
points.e: Vlinders is the unofficial title of an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Oost. Around 1998 artist Loes van der Horst designed, as a link between two buildings of the Flevohuis, two enormous blue-green light installations hanging from steel cables under the title Lichtinstallatie Flevoflat. However, it became known as Vlinders (Butterflies).

points.name: Vlucht van een kaketoe
points.e: Vlucht van een kaketoe is an artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The artwork, consisting of 27 panels, is placed in the pedestrian and cycle tunnel under the President Kennedylaan towards the Martin Luther Kingpark. The viaduct, known as Bridge 446, was brightened up in the period 2004 to 2008 by a collage by artist Jeroen Werner.

points.name: Vogelparade
points.e: Vogelparade is a multi-part artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Ko Aarts and Guido Vlottes were inspired by songbird enthusiasts, called Surinamese bird men in the neighbourhood. They held contests in the Bijlmerpark to see which little bird could produce the most song sounds, and people bet heavily on it.

points.name: Vogelvlucht
points.e: Vogelvlucht is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. In the second half of the 1950s the GVB built a new bus garage in the western district, to replace and expand its steadily growing bus fleet.

points.name: Volksvrouw
points.e: Volksvrouw is a sculpture by artist Henk Henriët. For a long time it looked as though the statue would never come. Henriët had already made the plaster statue in the 1930s, but he was by background not a sculptor; he was more a painter and draughtsman.

points.name: Vrouw bij vuur
points.e: Vrouw bij vuur and Man bij vuur are two small artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. They were designed by Frans Werner. The Vrouw bij vuur can be found on the side wall of Griftstraat 55, on the corner of the President Kennedyplantsoen. It depicts a woman warming her hands at a hearth. The gable stone is made of limestone.

points.name: Wapenschilden Kohnstammhuis
points.e: The Wapenschilden Kohnstammhuis are two artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Oost.

points.name: Waterkant
points.e: Het jongetje aan de waterkant is an artistic artwork on the Oudegracht in the Dutch town of Weesp.

points.name: Wiedster
points.e: De wiedster is an artistic artwork standing in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The statue was made by Hans IJdo. It depicts a woman weeding her garden. It stands on the grounds of the Vereniging Amateur Tuinders (amateur gardeners' association) on the Lies Bakhuyzenlaan in the Sloten neighbourhood.

points.name: Wiel
points.e: Het wiel is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Westpoort. It is, as artist Jeroen Henneman himself describes it, a standing drawing: lines in the air. Henneman used that technique more often in his oeuvre, see for example De kus, De Schreeuw and a number of wheels (upright or diagonal, etc.).

points.name: Willem van Oranje
points.e: Willem van Oranje is an equestrian relief in Amsterdam-Zuid. The 1934/1935 artwork by Johan Polet can be seen on the side wall of the Hervormd Lyceum Zuid, on the corner of the Brahmsstraat and the Schubertstraat. The statue, of Oberkirchner sandstone, was a gift from the Amsterdam municipality to the school. It was unveiled in July 1935.

points.name: Windbloemig
points.e: Windbloemig is an artistic artwork in Amstelveen. The statue is a creation by the duo Liet Heringa and Maarten van Kalsbeek. The statue from 2001 was then on view at the Kröller-Müller Museum during the exhibition Absorb by both artists.

points.name: Without title
points.e: Three untitled reliefs were placed on the facades of three residential blocks on the Blomwijckerpad in Amsterdam Nieuw-West when they were completed. The three share Biblical texts, apparently at the request of the client, the Christian housing association Patrimonium.

points.name: Without title
points.e: Three untitled reliefs were placed on the facades of three residential blocks on the Blomwijckerpad in Amsterdam Nieuw-West when they were completed. The three share Biblical texts, apparently at the request of the client, the Christian housing association Patrimonium.

points.name: Without title
points.e: An untitled artwork can be found on the facade of the building at Plesmanlaan 125 in Amsterdam. The work dates from 1959 and was made for the building of the Central Laboratory of the Blood Transfusion Service in Slotervaart, Amsterdam. The artist is Piet Donk (Leiden, 6 November 1904 - 29 March 1994).

points.name: Without title
points.e: An untitled artwork stands in front of the facade of the building at Plesmanlaan 125. The work dates from 1959 and was made for the building of the Central Laboratory of the Blood Transfusion Service in Slotervaart, Amsterdam. On the ground near the entrance stands a statue by Jan Wolkers. It is a stooping woman holding a child.

points.name: Wolk
points.e: Wolk is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-West. It is a creation by Han Schuil from 2003. The title was given by the Amsterdam municipality; the artist did not give his works titles until 2008, according to Het Parool (22 July 2020).

points.name: Zomer en winter
points.e: Zomer en winter are two small artistic artworks in Amsterdam-Zuid. They are works by Jaap Kaas, who made four sandstone facade reliefs for the building at Dijsselhofplantsoen 6. Teeuwisse lists the four in the oeuvre catalogue in Kaas' monograph as Zomer, Winter, Slapende kat and Slapende hond.

points.name: Zonder titel
points.t: Zonder titel (Jan van Goethem, Pieter Nieuwlandstraat)
points.e: An untitled artistic artwork by Jan van Goethem has been placed in the southern facade wall of the Pieter Nieuwlandstraat in Amsterdam-Oost. It is one of a twin pair; a copy also hangs in the Reinwardtstraat around the corner.

points.name: Zonder titel
points.e: An untitled mural is on the facade of a building on the corner of the Zeeburgerdijk and the Molukkenstraat in Amsterdam-Oost, in the Dutch municipality of Amsterdam. On the side of the Molukkenstraat (house number 1) the corner is an almost completely blind brick wall, broken only by four small windows and a door.

points.name: Zonder titel
points.e: An untitled artistic artwork stands at the edge of the Eerste Marnixplantsoen in Amsterdam-Centrum. The work dates from 1988 and is by Sigurður Guðmundsson. It is built of stone, glass and bronze, the bronze serving as a frame for the glass.

points.name: Zonder titel (Fredy E. Wubben)
points.e: On the square at the south-eastern end of the Reigersbos street stand several untitled sculptures by Fredy E. Wubben. They all have an arch shape. Basisschool De Tamboerijn at Reigersbos 301 asked this artist to design several artistic artworks to emphasise the entrances to the school complex.

points.name: Zonder titel (Han Schuil)
points.e: Two untitled artistic artworks stand at Duivendrecht station, in the municipality of Ouder-Amstel. Before the station opened in 1993, artist Han Schuil was commissioned to make art objects. He came up with six pieces of steel, attached three by three to the embankment of the span that carries the station.

points.name: Zonder titel (Jan van Goethem, Reinwardtstraat)
points.e: An untitled artistic artwork by Jan van Goethem has been placed in the northern facade wall of the Reinwardtstraat in Amsterdam-Oost. It is one of a twin pair; a copy also hangs in the Pieter Nieuwlandstraat around the corner.

points.name: Zonnehoofd
points.e: Zonnehoofd is an artistic artwork in Amsterdam-Zuid. The statue by Carel Kneulman began as a commission from the Rotterdam municipality. It was meant to brighten up the Hoogvliet neighbourhood.

points.name: All Aboard
points.e: Hans van Bentem (The Hague, 14 June 1965) is a visual artist and painter of contemporary art.

points.name: Can't see the Wood for the Trees
points.t: Can't see the Wood for the Trees
points.e: Can't see the Wood for the Trees is a 12-metre-high stainless steel sculpture from 2002 by visual artist Richard Deacon. It stands at the Rottepolderplein interchange, where the N205 connects to the A9, by the De Liede industrial estate in the Dutch municipality of Haarlemmermeer.

points.name: Christus Koning
points.e: Christus Koning is a statue and war memorial in the Dutch town of Zaandam.

points.name: de kunstenaar wijst de weg naar de hemel
Drie figuren op straat
points.e: Drie figuren op straat is a sculpture group in the Staatsliedenbuurt, Amsterdam Oud-West. The three walking figures, within the genre 'figurative with an expressive form' (according to the artist), were designed by Peter Erftemeijer.

points.a: Joep Johannes Petrus Antonius van Lieshout

points.name: Fontein - Virtual fountains
points.e: Virtual fountains is a three-part artistic artwork (spring, waterfall and fountain) in Amsterdam-Zuid.

points.name: Henri Pronker - Stringskater
points.e: Henri Luwen Pronker (Dordrecht, 11 August 1956 - 1 June 2023) was a striking presence in the streets of Amsterdam in the 1980s and 1990s.

points.name: Houtwerker
points.e: De Houtwerker is a four-metre-high statue designed by the Yugoslav sculptor Slavomir Miletić. The statue, which the Zaan municipal council had commissioned as an ornament for the new Beatrix bridge, was however rejected by the council on 10 June 1963 on 'aesthetic and technical grounds'.

points.name: Olympische groet
points.e: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) uses icons, flags, and symbols to represent and enhance the Olympic Games. These symbols include those commonly used during Olympic competitions such as the flame, fanfare, and theme as well as those used both during and outside competition, such as the Olympic flag.
